english: Debyosy stands on the Cheptsa, a tributary of the Vyatka. It first appears in the 1646 census as a new settlement on the Debeska stream. A wooden Church of Saint Nicholas was begun in 1749 and completed in 1754, giving the settlement the standing of a church village; it burned in 1756 and was rebuilt in 1767. Debyosy became a volost center in 1796. Early in the nineteenth century two branches of the Siberian road met here, one from Moscow and the other from Saint Petersburg.
simp_chinese: 杰比奥瑟位于维亚特卡河支流切普察河畔。1646年的人口调查首次将它记为杰别斯卡溪边的新聚落。圣尼古拉木教堂于1749年动工、1754年建成，使聚落获得教堂村庄的地位；教堂1756年毁于火灾，1767年重建。1796年，杰比奥瑟成为乡治。十九世纪初，西伯利亚道路来自莫斯科和圣彼得堡的两条支线在此汇合。

english: Dechang lies in the long valley of the Anning River, between the mountains of southern Sichuan. The river runs south from the high country past Xichang and Dechang before joining the Yalong. Its fertile valley offers a striking contrast to the steep slopes on either side. Local fragrant rice became particularly valued, and was sent as tribute during the Qing dynasty.
simp_chinese: 德昌位于川南群山之间的安宁河谷。安宁河从北方高地流下，经过西昌、德昌，最后汇入雅砻江。肥沃的河谷与两侧陡峭山坡形成鲜明对照。当地香米尤为珍贵，清代曾作为贡米进献。

english:
Děčín occupies a narrow, low river corridor near the German border, where the Ploučnice enters the Elbe. It lies between the Elbe Sandstone Mountains to the north and the Central Bohemian Uplands to the south, and its main built-up area stands at only 135 meters above sea level. The river crossing made the site useful from early times: settlement dates to the La Tène period, Slavic occupation is documented from the seventh century, and a trade route crossed the Elbe at this ford. A Přemyslid stronghold guarded the waterway; a stone castle replaced it in the thirteenth century, and King Ottokar II founded a royal town beneath the castle.

Děčín’s later importance came from movement. The Bünau family’s Renaissance rebuilding accompanied flourishing Elbe trade, quarries, lime making, and brickworks. The Thirty Years’ War brought occupation and decline, but the river trade went on giving the town its place on the Elbe. The castle above the Elbe preserves the long link between fortified authority and the crossing, while the river valley remains the organizing line of the city. Its geography explains both recurring prosperity and vulnerability to floods.
simp_chinese:
杰钦位于德国边境附近一条低而狭窄的河谷中，普卢奇尼采河在此汇入易北河。城镇夹在北面的易北砂岩山地与南面的中波希米亚高地之间，主要建成区海拔仅135米。这里的渡河位置很早就发挥作用：当地人类活动可追溯到拉坦诺时期，七世纪已有斯拉夫聚落，贸易道路从此处涉水过河。普热美斯王朝的设防据点守护水道，十三世纪又由石砌城堡取代；鄂图卡二世后来在城堡下方建立王城。

杰钦后来的重要性来自人员与货物的流动。比瑙家族改建文艺复兴式城堡时，易北河贸易、采石、石灰生产和制砖业也同步兴盛。三十年战争带来占领与衰落，但易北河贸易仍继续支撑着城镇的地位。俯瞰易北河的城堡保留了军事权威与渡口之间的长期联系，河谷则始终是城市组织的轴线。这种地理格局既带来繁荣，也使城镇屡受洪水威胁。

english: Ded-Khulsun lies in the steppe country near the Sarpinsky lakes west of the lower Volga. The lakes occupy a chain of shallow depressions along the eastern side of the Ergeni hills, remnants of an ancient Volga channel. Their waters and surrounding reeds stand out against the dry grasslands, where water and pasture vary with the seasons. The low country between the hills and the river formed part of the grazing lands used by the pastoral peoples of the region.
simp_chinese: 杰德胡尔孙位于伏尔加河下游以西、萨尔帕湖群附近的草原地带。这些湖泊占据叶尔根尼丘陵东侧一连串浅洼地，是古代伏尔加河道的遗存。湖水和周围芦苇在干旱草原中格外醒目，水源与牧草随季节变化。丘陵和河流之间的低地曾是本地区牧民使用的放牧土地。

english: Dedesi is remembered as an ancestral river beneath the Drakensberg, in the upper Mzimvubu country. Traditions connect its valley with the early histories of the Xhosa, Thembu and Mpondomise. One account tells how Malangana led the abaMbo across the Umzimkhulu and settled near the river's source, where they joined communities under Togu and Hala. Other traditions remember a later movement from Dedesi towards the coast, led by the Xhosa chief Sikomo.
simp_chinese: 德德西在传统记忆中是一条位于德拉肯斯山下、姆济姆武布河上游地区的祖先之河。其河谷与科萨、滕布和姆蓬多米塞人的早期历史相联系。一种说法讲述马兰加纳带领阿班博人渡过乌姆津库鲁河，在德德西河源附近定居，与托古和哈拉领导的社群相聚。另一些传统记述，科萨首领西科莫后来带领人们从德德西向海岸迁移。

sources.title: Soga J H The South Eastern Bantu 1930.pdf

english:
Deepdene Coast occupies the ocean margin of Western Australia, the continent’s largest state. The coastline runs from the tropical north to temperate southern waters. In the west and north it faces the Indian Ocean; south of the continent, Australian official usage calls the same broad body part of the Southern Ocean. The shore is not one uniform environment. Its hinterland includes Kimberley sandstone gorges, the drier Pilbara and Carnarvon shrublands, the Southwest Australia savanna, and the Jarrah-Karri forests around the southwest corner. Offshore currents and coastal habitats therefore connect several distinct climatic and ecological worlds.

People have crossed and used these waters for many generations. Indigenous peoples have lived in Western Australia for tens of thousands of years, and Dutch voyagers reached its coast in the seventeenth century. British colonization began with the Swan River Colony in 1829, while gold discoveries later drew large populations inland. Along the coast, fishing and maritime trade became enduring parts of the economy. Rock lobster, prawns, crabs, shark, and tuna have supplied local and export markets, and pearling developed in the Kimberley. These activities show the coast as a working boundary between inland settlements and productive ocean waters.
simp_chinese:
迪普迪恩海岸位于西澳大利亚外海边缘。西澳大利亚是澳大利亚面积最大的州，海岸从热带北部一直延伸至温带南部水域。西侧和北侧面向印度洋；在大陆南侧，澳大利亚官方把这片广阔海域的一部分称为南冰洋。沿岸并非单一环境，其腹地包括金伯利砂岩峡谷、较干燥的皮尔巴拉和卡那封灌丛、西南澳大利亚稀树草原，以及西南角的红桉与卡里林。海流和近岸生境因此把多个气候与生态区域连接起来。

世代以来，人们穿越并利用这片海域。原住民在澳大利亚西部生活了数万年，荷兰航海者在十七世纪抵达海岸。1829年，英国以天鹅河殖民地的建立开启殖民统治，后来的淘金潮又把大量人口引向内陆。渔业和海上贸易长期构成沿岸经济的一部分，西澳岩龙虾、对虾、蟹、鲨鱼和金枪鱼供应本地及出口市场，采珠业则在金伯利发展起来。这些行业说明，海岸既是内陆聚落的边缘，也是富有生产力的海上空间。

english: Deer Lodge Valley lies among the mountains of the upper Clark Fork, a broad basin of grassland and streams. A hot spring built a mineral mound, whose salty deposits attracted deer and other animals. The formation gave the valley its name. Salish, Kootenai, Pend d'Oreille, Nez Perce and Shoshone people gathered in this part of the mountain country, where valleys and passes connected their homelands with hunting grounds on either side of the divide.
simp_chinese: 迪尔洛奇谷地位于克拉克福克河上游的群山之间，是一片有草地与溪流的宽阔盆地。温泉形成一座矿物丘，含盐沉积吸引鹿和其他动物前来舔食；谷地也因此得名。萨利什人、库特奈人、彭德奥雷耶人、内兹珀斯人和肖肖尼人曾在这一带聚集，山谷和山口将他们的故土与分水岭两侧的猎场连接起来。

english:
Deg’xit’an Forest takes its name from the Deg Xitʼan, an Athabaskan people of Alaska whose homeland is organized around rivers. Their communities are recorded at Anvik on the Anvik River, Shageluk on the Innoko River, and Holy Cross on the lower Yukon. In such a northern forest country, waterways serve as the clearest corridors through a broad landscape of woodland, wetland, and seasonal ground.

Settlement along these rivers keeps the forest from appearing as an undifferentiated emptiness: the land is a network of fishing places, travel routes, and communities linked to nearby Athabaskan and Yupik neighbours. The Deg Xitʼan are members of the federally recognized Alaska Native tribes of Anvik Village, Shageluk Native Village, and Holy Cross Village. Their trails also shaped later movement. The routes that preceded the Iditarod Trail included Native paths used by the Dena’ina, Deg Hitʼan, and Iñupiaq.

That history makes the forest a corridor as well as a habitat. Travel followed rivers and established overland lines, connecting communities while accommodating the constraints of cold, water, and distance. The landscape associated with the Deg Xitʼan is therefore best understood through the places its people know and the routes that join them.
simp_chinese:
德格希坦森林得名于阿拉斯加阿萨巴斯卡民族德格希坦人，他们的家园围绕河流组织。资料记载的社群分布于安维克河的安维克、伊诺科河的沙格卢克，以及育空河下游的圣十字。在这类北方森林地带，水道是穿越林地、湿地和随季节变化地面的主要通道。

沿河分布的聚落让森林不再是抽象的空白，而成为由捕鱼地点、交通路线和社区组成的网络，并与邻近的阿萨巴斯卡民族和尤皮克人相互联系。德格希坦人属于安维克村、沙格卢克原住民村和圣十字村等获联邦承认的阿拉斯加原住民部落。他们的道路也影响了后来的交通。艾迪塔罗德步道以前的部分路线，来自德纳伊纳人、德格希坦人和伊努皮亚克人使用的原住民小径。

因此，森林既是生境，也是走廊。旅行者沿河而行，并使用长期形成的陆上路线，在寒冷、水网和距离的限制下连接不同社区。理解这片土地，需要同时看见德格希坦人熟悉的地点，以及把这些地点连接起来的道路。

english:
Degehabur rises on a plateau in the Jarar country of the Somali lands at 1,044 meters above sea level, on the edge of the Haud, a wide dry grassland. Its Somali name, Dhagaxbuur, means “stone hill”. Somali pastoral clans moved their camels, goats and sheep across this country with the seasons, relying on wells, seasonal pools and scattered patches of cultivation, where sorghum was grown wherever rain allowed.

Its position mattered because of movement. Caravans crossing the Haud toward Hargeisa and Berbera on the Gulf of Aden used it as an important stopping place, and tracks converged here through grazing country and settlement clusters, so that travellers, goods and news could meet before entering another part of the regional network. A plateau market centre like this could flourish while the routes were safe and wither when feuds closed them.
simp_chinese:
德格哈布尔位于索马里人聚居地贾拉尔地区的一处高原上，海拔1044米，坐落在豪德这片辽阔干燥草原的边缘。它的索马里语名称 Dhagaxbuur 意为“石头山”。索马里牧民部族随季节赶着骆驼、山羊和绵羊穿越这片土地，依靠水井、季节性水塘和零星的耕地维持生活，雨水允许的地方种植高粱。

它的重要性来自交通。穿越豪德前往哈尔格萨和亚丁湾畔柏培拉的商队把这里作为重要停歇点，道路从牧区和成组聚落汇入，使旅客、货物与消息在进入区域网络的另一段之前能在此相遇。这样的高原集市在路线安全时兴旺，一旦世仇阻断道路便会衰落。

english: Deh-e Kord lies on the high eastern side of the Zagros, among the plains and mountains of Chahar Mahal. Cold winters and mountain streams distinguish this upland country from the hot lowlands of Khuzestan. The surrounding heights formed summer pasture for Bakhtiari pastoralists, who crossed the mountain passes with their flocks to spend winter on the western foothills.
simp_chinese: 代赫库尔德位于扎格罗斯山脉东侧的高地，坐落在恰哈尔马哈尔的平原与山地之间。寒冷冬季和山间溪流使这片高地与炎热的胡齐斯坦低地截然不同。周围高山是巴赫蒂亚里牧民的夏季牧场，他们带着牲畜翻越山口，在西侧山麓过冬。

english: Deh Kundi lies in the central Afghan highlands known as Hazarajat, a land of steep mountains and isolated valleys. Nili stands among these uplands, where the sources of great rivers flow toward different parts of Afghanistan. The area takes its name from the Daykundi Hazara, one of the communities of the highlands. Their settlements occupy a landscape shaped by cold winters and difficult mountain routes.
simp_chinese: 德昆迪位于阿富汗中部的哈扎拉贾特高地，这里群山陡峭，谷地相互隔绝。尼利坐落在这片高地之中，多条大河从附近山地发源，流向阿富汗各地。这一地区以高地居民中的戴昆迪哈扎拉人命名，他们的聚落分布在冬季严寒、山路艰险的土地上。

english:
Dehaq is a town in Mehrdasht District of Najafabad County, on the high plateau east of the Zagros Mountains, in the irrigated country west of Isfahan. This is dry interior land where settlements depend on wells, channels and careful use of arable land, drawing on the water of the Zayandeh River basin. Villages like Dehaq were small centres in the hinterland of Isfahan, which became the Safavid capital in 1598 and drew grain, fruit and craft goods from the surrounding countryside.

Gardens, household plots and shade trees mark the deliberate creation of colour, shade and food within a dry setting, and the plateau is not naturally lush. Dehaq’s identity therefore rests on the ordinary work of maintaining a settlement on Iran’s central plateau: household water use, cultivation, and ties along the roads toward Isfahan.
simp_chinese:
德哈格是纳杰法巴德县迈赫尔达什特区的一座城镇，位于扎格罗斯山脉以东的高原上，处在伊斯法罕以西的灌溉地带。这里属于干燥的内陆，聚落依靠水井、渠道和对耕地的谨慎利用，水源取自宰因代河流域。德哈格这样的村镇是伊斯法罕腹地中的小中心；伊斯法罕在1598年成为萨法维王朝的都城，从周围乡村获取粮食、水果和手工制品。

园圃、宅旁地块和遮荫树木，显示居民在干燥环境中主动营造色彩、树荫与食物；高原本身并不天然湿润。德哈格的地方身份因此建立于伊朗中央高原上的日常经营：家庭用水、栽培活动，以及通往伊斯法罕方向的道路联系。

english: Dehaj lies north of Shahr-e Babak in the dry northwestern country of Kerman. Mountains and broad plains surround the settlement, and its old congregational mosque is among the district's historic buildings. Dehaj is also associated with a tradition of fine rug weaving, particularly among its Arab inhabitants. Such textiles joined the work of local households to the wider weaving traditions of southeastern Persia.
simp_chinese: 德哈吉位于沙赫尔巴巴克以北、克尔曼西北部干燥的地区。聚落周围有山地和宽阔平原，旧聚礼清真寺是当地的历史建筑之一。德哈吉也以精美地毯的编织传统著称，尤其与当地阿拉伯居民有关。这些织物将地方家庭的手艺与波斯东南部更广泛的织造传统联系起来。

english: Dehcho is the Slavey name for the Mackenzie River, which means “big river”. The plains of this area lie in the country the Muskwa River crosses on its way east. Steep Rocky Mountain foothills give way to subalpine and boreal forest, and the river then meanders across the muskeg and forest of the vast Liard River plains. Near the town of Fort Nelson the Muskwa joins the Fort Nelson River, and its waters flow on into the Mackenzie system.
simp_chinese: 德乔是斯拉维人对马更些河的称呼，意为“大河”。这一游戏地点的平原位于马斯夸河向东流经的地区：落基山北麓的陡坡逐渐过渡为亚高山与北方针叶林，河水随后在利亚德河广阔的平原上蜿蜒，穿过泥炭沼泽与森林。马斯夸河在纳尔逊堡镇附近汇入纳尔逊堡河，水流最终并入马更些河水系。

english: Mountains rise west of the Deh Cho, broken by the valleys of rivers that flow east towards the Mackenzie. Among them the South Nahanni cuts a course through the ranges, passing great falls and deep canyons before joining the Liard. Dene people have travelled and hunted in these mountains for thousands of years, following natural corridors and the movements of animals. Stories and place names preserve their knowledge of this rugged country.
simp_chinese: 德乔河以西群山耸立，向东流往马更些河的河流在山间切出谷地。其中南纳汉尼河穿过山脉，经过巨大的瀑布和深峡，最终汇入利亚德河。数千年来，德内人顺着天然通道和动物迁徙的路线在山中往来狩猎；故事与地名保存着他们对这片崎岖土地的认识。

english: East of the great Deh Cho, forests and wetlands spread across the northern interior. The river and its tributaries form a network through a landscape where Dene families travelled according to the seasons, fishing and hunting over wide areas. Farther south, Trout Lake and its streams were known through a rich collection of Dene place names. Fish taken there in autumn could be dried or smoked for the long winter.
simp_chinese: 大河德乔以东，森林与湿地遍布北方内陆。大河及其支流组成水道网络，德内家庭随季节在广阔地区迁徙、捕鱼和狩猎。更靠南的鳟鱼湖及其溪流拥有众多德内语地名；人们在秋季捕获鱼类，晒干或熏制，以备漫长冬季食用。河岸和湖边的名称也记录了人们对这片土地的熟悉。

english:
Dehdasht occupies a plain among the southwestern Zagros mountains. Its old city, known as Bilad Shapur and later associated with Kohgiluyeh, preserves extensive stone-built remains. Mosques, baths, a bazaar and caravanserai stood within a town protected by walls and towers, while houses filled the streets between them. The ruins reveal an urban centre rather than an isolated mountain settlement.

Under the Safavids Dehdasht was an important centre of Kohgiluyeh and a stopping place in trade with the southern ports. Merchants and travellers used the caravanserai, while religious and public buildings served its inhabitants. The town later declined, leaving its stone buildings to mark the former extent of a city that once connected the Zagros valleys with the lowlands and the Persian Gulf.
simp_chinese:
德赫达什特坐落在扎格罗斯山脉西南部的平原上。老城曾称比拉德沙普尔，后来与科赫吉卢耶之名相联系，留有大片石建筑遗迹。清真寺、浴室、集市和商队旅舍坐落在城墙与塔楼保护之内，住宅充满其间街巷。这些遗址显示这里曾是一座城市，而非孤立的山地聚落。

萨法维时期，德赫达什特是科赫吉卢耶的重要中心，也是通往南方港口贸易的停留点。商人和旅客使用商队旅舍，宗教与公共建筑则服务当地居民。城镇后来衰落，留下石建筑标示昔日城市的范围；它曾连接扎格罗斯山谷、低地与波斯湾。

english:
Dehdez lies among the high ridges of the central Zagros in the high ridges of the central Zagros above Khuzestan, where mountain pastures and sheltered valleys meet the approaches to the hotter lowlands. Bakhtiari Lur communities used the surrounding country for seasonal herding, moving flocks between winter pastures and high summer grazing grounds. Villages on the lower slopes combined this pastoral economy with grain, fruit and walnut cultivation.

The region was drawn into the orbit of the Lor Atabegs and later the Safavid state, but central authority remained indirect. Local khans, tribal chiefs and fortress holders mediated taxation and military service. Dehdez’s older name, Dezpart, links it to a fortified district whose difficult roads protected communities from lowland armies and rival confederations.

During the eighteenth century the collapse of Safavid power allowed Bakhtiari chiefs to act with greater independence. The Zand and Qajar states sought alliances with powerful khans rather than permanent occupation of every valley. Dehdez’s sixteenth- to eighteenth-century identity therefore rested on mountain routes, tribal authority and pasture, together with small-scale farming in the valleys.
simp_chinese:
德德兹位于今胡齐斯坦境内的扎格罗斯中部高山，山地牧场与受遮蔽谷地在附近通向炎热低地。巴赫蒂亚里卢尔社群利用周边乡野季节性放牧，在冬季草场与夏季高地之间迁移畜群；低坡村落同时种植谷物、果树和核桃。

这里先后进入卢尔阿塔贝格与萨法维国家的势力范围，但中央权力始终通过间接方式运作。地方汗、部族首领和堡垒持有人负责协调赋税与兵役。德德兹旧称“德兹帕尔特”，与该设防地区相联系，艰险道路使社群得以抵御低地军队和敌对联盟。

十八世纪，萨法维权力崩溃，使巴赫蒂亚里首领获得更大自主性。赞德与卡扎尔国家选择同强大汗王结盟，而不是长期驻扎每一个山谷。德德兹的早期近代身份因此由山口、部族权威、牧场和谷地农业共同构成。

english:
Dehgolan stands on the high plateau of Iran's Kurdistan province, in a Kurdish landscape of broad plains, dry hills and seasonal pasture. Snow-fed streams and wells determine where grain, orchards and villages can flourish, while surrounding uplands provide grazing for sheep and goats. Winters are cold and summers dry.

Kurdish communities organized settlement through villages, kinship and tribal alliances. Wheat, barley, fruit and livestock supplied local markets, and routes across the plateau connected the district with Sanandaj, Qorveh and the plains farther east. Pastoral families moved between lowland winter pasture and cooler summer ground.

The town's identity belongs to this regional rural highland world rather than to a single administrative reform. Its position at a route junction made it a market and meeting place for surrounding villages, while the open plateau supported a dispersed pattern of settlement. Highland passes and spring pastures connected its villages to the markets of the wider Zagros country.
simp_chinese:
代赫戈兰位于伊朗库尔德斯坦省的高原地带，处在宽阔平原、干燥丘陵和季节性牧场构成的库尔德景观中。雪水溪流与水井决定谷物、果园和村落能否发展，周围高地则提供绵羊与山羊牧场。冬季寒冷，夏季干燥。

库尔德社群通过村庄、亲缘与部落联盟组织聚落。小麦、大麦、果品和牲畜供应地方市场，穿越高原的道路把本区同萨南达季、库尔韦及更东面的平原相连。牧民家庭在低地冬季牧场与凉爽夏季牧场之间迁徙。

城镇身份属于这一乡村高地世界，而非某一次行政改制。它位于道路交会处，成为周围村庄的市场与会面地点，开阔高原则维持分散的聚落格局。高地山口和春季牧场把当地村庄同更广阔扎格罗斯地区的市场连接起来。

english:
Dehistan was an oasis on the dry plain east of the Caspian Sea, watered by canals and dotted with settlements. Its principal medieval town, Mishrian, lay on a caravan route between Gurgan and Khwarazm. Fortified walls, caravanserais and mosques marked a prosperous centre of trade, while the nearby cemetery of Mashat contained the tombs of its inhabitants.

The Khwarazmshahs sponsored some of Dehistan's finest buildings, including monuments whose tall brick minarets still rise above the plain. In the thirteenth century the Mongol invasions brought destruction to the region. The oasis eventually declined as its irrigation system ceased to sustain the cultivated land, leaving the monuments amid an arid landscape. Their decorated brickwork recalls a time when a thriving town stood on this desert route.
simp_chinese:
德希斯坦是里海以东干旱平原上的一片绿洲，水渠灌溉着散布其间的聚落。绿洲的中世纪中心密昔里安位于古尔甘通往花剌子模的商道上；城墙、商队驿站和清真寺显示了这座贸易中心的繁荣，附近的马沙特墓地则安葬着当地居民。

花剌子模沙王朝资助了德希斯坦一些最精美的建筑，其中砖砌宣礼塔高耸于平原之上。十三世纪蒙古入侵给这一地区带来破坏。后来灌溉系统无法继续维持耕地，绿洲逐渐衰落，建筑遗迹留在干旱的土地上。装饰精美的砖工仍令人想起沙漠商道上曾经繁荣的城镇。

english:
Dehloran lies on the southern edge of Ilam province, where mountain routes descend to the Dehloran Plain near the Mesopotamian lowlands. Seasonal rivers and springs made the plain a meeting point for settled farmers, herders and travelers between Iran and Iraq.

The surrounding plain contains some of western Iran's oldest farming settlements. Ali Kosh, Chogha Sefid, Tepe Sabz and Tepe Farukhabad record early villages, irrigation and herding from the Neolithic into the Chalcolithic period. Pottery, stone tools and plant remains show the gradual domestication of wheat, barley, sheep and goats.

Later Lur and Kurdish communities used the same borderland for pasture and trade. Roads through Dehloran connected the Zagros foothills to Susiana and Iraq, while date gardens and grain fields occupied the irrigated plain. Its early importance came from water, rich soil and passage between highland and lowland worlds. Floodwater farming and date gardens supported the plain villages, while roads linked them to both Susiana and the Zagros highlands.
simp_chinese:
德洛兰位于伊拉姆省南缘，山地道路在这里下降到靠近美索不达米亚低地的德洛兰平原。季节河与泉眼使平原有定居农民、牧民以及往来伊朗和伊拉克的旅人。

周边平原保存着西伊朗最古老的一些农业聚落。阿里科什、乔加塞菲德、塔佩萨布兹和塔佩法鲁哈巴德记录新石器时代至铜石并用时代的村落、灌溉与畜牧。陶器、石器和植物遗存显示小麦、大麦、绵羊和山羊逐渐驯化。

后来的卢尔人与库尔德人继续把同一边疆用于放牧和贸易。德洛兰道路连接扎格罗斯山麓、苏西安纳和伊拉克，枣园与粮田分布在灌溉平原。早期重要性来自水源、沃土以及高地与低地世界之间的通道。洪水农业和枣园维持平原村庄，道路又把它们同苏西安纳和扎格罗斯高地连接。

english:
Dehram lies in the dry country of Fars, where the mountains of southern Iran open toward lower plains. The settlement stands near routes linking Farashband with neighbouring districts, in a landscape of hot summers, sparse winter rain and saline water. Gardens, date palms and irrigated plots cluster around reliable wells and channels.

The name appears in several forms, including Dihram, and local traditions connect it with a large green settlement. Farming villages supplied caravans and district centres while qanats and seasonal streams sustained cultivation. Sesame, vegetables, dates and fruit depended on careful water management.

Dehram’s small centre grew around exchange between orchards and pastoral country. Its position at a district crossroads gave the settlement administrative and commercial importance within the dry basin.
simp_chinese:
德赫拉姆位于法尔斯干旱地区，南伊朗山地在这里向较低平原展开。聚落靠近连接法拉什班德与邻区的道路，周围夏季炎热、冬雨稀少、水源含盐。园圃、枣椰和灌溉地块集中在水井与渠道可靠之处。

这一地名有数种写法，地方传统将它同较大的绿色聚落联系起来。农耕村落为商旅和地区中心提供粮食，坎儿井与季节溪流维持耕作。芝麻、蔬菜、枣椰和水果仰赖谨慎管理的水源。

德赫拉姆的小型中心围绕果园与牧区之间的交换发展。道路交汇的位置使它在干旱盆地中拥有行政和商业作用。人口稀少的村庄沿水井和泉水分散分布，狭窄道路又把园圃、牧地与市场连接起来。

english: Dehshir lies in the Abarkuh area. As regional background, Abarkuh stood at a junction of routes from Shiraz, Isfahan and Yazd. Writing in 1340, Hamdallah Mustawfi described Abarkuh as a small, prosperous town where qanats and surface channels watered fields of grain and cotton.
simp_chinese: 德希尔位于阿巴尔库地区。作为区域背景，阿巴尔库位于设拉子、伊斯法罕和亚兹德道路交会处。哈姆达拉·穆斯塔菲在1340年将阿巴尔库描述为规模不大却繁荣的城镇，田中的谷物和棉花依靠坎儿井及地表渠道灌溉。

english:
Deshkan Ziibi, the Antler River, is the Anishinaabe name for the river later called the Thames. Its branches drain the country between Lake Huron and Lake Erie before flowing west towards Lake St Clair. The Chippewas of the Thames and neighbouring peoples maintained their own relationships with the river and its lands long before British settlement expanded along its banks.

In 1793 Lieutenant-Governor John Graves Simcoe named the river the Thames and chose its forks as a possible site for the capital of Upper Canada. During the War of 1812, Chippewa warriors fought in the defence of the river at the Battle of Moraviantown in 1813. In the years that followed, the Chippewas of the Thames made the Longwoods Treaty with the British; written versions were recorded in 1819, 1820 and 1822.
simp_chinese:
德赫斯坎齐比意为“鹿角河”，是阿尼希纳贝人对后来被称为泰晤士河的水道的名称。它的支流汇集休伦湖与伊利湖之间的水，向西流往圣克莱尔湖。英国移民沿岸扩张之前，泰晤士河奇珀瓦人及邻近族群早已与河流和土地维持自己的关系。

1793年，副总督约翰·格雷夫斯·辛科将河流命名为泰晤士河，并选定支流汇合处作为上加拿大首府的候选地点。1812年战争期间，奇珀瓦战士参与了1813年莫拉维亚镇之战，防守这条河。此后，泰晤士河奇珀瓦人与英国人订立朗伍兹条约，1819、1820和1822年留下了不同的书面版本。

english: Dehtal lies in the southern Iranian hinterland between the Zagros and the Persian Gulf. On the plain near the village, figures were pecked into darkened boulders across a landscape extending towards the surrounding foothills. Animals, people, plants and symbols appear among the carvings, some of which may date back to prehistoric times, while others belong to later historical periods.
simp_chinese: 德赫塔尔位于伊朗南部内陆，介于扎格罗斯山脉与波斯湾之间。村庄附近的平原上，散布着刻有图像的深色巨石，岩刻地带一直延伸至周围山麓。动物、人物、植物与符号都出现在这些图案中；其中一些可能追溯至史前时代，另一些则属于后来的历史时期。

english:
Dehua is a county in central Fujian under the administration of Quanzhou City. Its territory covers 2,232 square kilometres. The county combines a mountain landscape with communities spread through its towns and townships rather than concentrating all activity in one administrative point.

Its reputation rests on ceramics. Dehua holds rich deposits of kaolin, the essential clay for porcelain, and became famous for ceramic products ranging from dinnerware and jars to vases, plaques, garden ornaments and figures of people and animals. The surviving range shows that local workshops served both practical household needs and decorative markets. Kilns at Dehua were already producing porcelain in the Song period. A Ming-dynasty qilin made in Dehua porcelain illustrates the skill and symbolic vocabulary associated with its kilns. The county’s economy and identity therefore developed from the meeting of abundant raw material, specialized craft and access to wider markets through Quanzhou. That combination made Dehua a lasting name in Chinese porcelain production, while its towns, townships and rural settlements supported the complex network of workshops and trade behind the finished wares.
simp_chinese:
德化县位于福建中部，由泉州市管辖，县域面积2232平方公里。这里兼具山地环境与分布于各镇、乡的聚落，行政、生产与日常生活并未全部集中在一个城区。

德化最为人所知的是陶瓷。当地拥有丰富的高岭土，这是制瓷所需的重要原料；德化以陶瓷产品闻名，器类包括餐具、罐、花瓶、壁板、园林装饰以及人物和动物塑像。现存器物范围表明，当地作坊既满足日常家用，也服务于装饰品市场。德化的窑场在宋代已经烧造瓷器。一件明代德化瓷麒麟，体现了当地窑业掌握的造型技术和吉祥图案传统。德化的经济与地域声誉由此建立在原料、专门技艺和经由泉州进入更广阔市场的结合之上。正是城镇、乡间聚落、窑场与贸易网络共同支撑了成品流通，使德化长期成为中国制瓷业的重要名称。

english:
Déhuà lies in Jiangxi, on the southern approach to Mount Lu. The mountain rises abruptly above the Yangtze plain, creating cool uplands, cloud forest and waterfalls. Tea, timber and Buddhist temples gave the slopes a sacred and commercial importance.

Mount Lu became a major religious centre during the Tang and Song periods. Monasteries attracted pilgrims and scholars, while paths and bridges linked them to Jiujiang and the Yangtze trade. The surrounding district supplied tea, grain, charcoal and labor to the mountain communities.

Lianxi remained a rural district within the Jiujiang prefecture. Its villages occupied low hills between the river plain and Mount Lu, with local markets connected by roads and waterways. Déhuà's early identity belongs to the pilgrimage economy and mountain agriculture around one of eastern China's most famous landscape sites. Tea gardens, bamboo groves and monastery estates occupied the mountain slopes, while pilgrims and merchants connected them with Jiujiang.
simp_chinese:
德化位于江西九江一带，处在庐山南麓入口。山峰在长江平原上骤然升起，形成凉爽高地、云雾林和瀑布。茶叶、木材与佛寺赋予坡地宗教和商业意义。

唐宋时期，庐山成为重要宗教中心。寺院吸引朝圣者和学者，小径与桥梁把它们同九江及长江贸易相连。周边地区向山地社群供应茶叶、粮食、木炭和劳力。

濂溪长期是九江府内乡村地区。村庄位于江平原与庐山之间的低丘，地方集市通过道路和水路相连。德化的早期身份属于中国东部著名景观周围的朝圣经济与山地农业。茶园、竹林和寺院庄园分布于山坡，朝圣者与商人把它们同九江连接。

english: Deir ez-Zor stands on the Euphrates where the river crosses the dry Syrian steppe. Ottoman records mention a small settlement here amid a sparsely inhabited stretch of the valley. Cultivated land followed the river and its canals, while pastoral tribes moved seasonally through the Jazira and the desert beyond. The town lay on the route between Aleppo and Baghdad, near older centres farther downstream at the Khabur confluence and al-Rahba.
simp_chinese: 代尔祖尔位于幼发拉底河畔，河水在此穿过干燥的叙利亚草原。奥斯曼记录提及这一人口稀少河谷中的小聚落。耕地沿河流和水渠分布，游牧部族则随季节往来杰济拉及其外侧的荒漠。城镇处在阿勒颇通往巴格达的路线上，下游的哈布尔河汇入口和赖赫巴附近还有更古老的中心。

english:
Deir al-Qamar lies in the Shuf mountains of Lebanon, its stone houses and palaces gathered around a central square. From the sixteenth to eighteenth centuries it served as a residence of the Ma'n and Shihab emirs, who governed the mountain districts under Ottoman sovereignty. Mosques, a synagogue and the houses of Christian and Druze inhabitants reflected the varied communities of the town.

Emir Fakhr al-Din II made Deir al-Qamar one of his principal residences and built a palace there in the early seventeenth century. After conflict with the Ottomans he spent several years in Tuscany, returning in 1618 before his eventual defeat and execution in 1635. Later Shihab rulers also resided in the town. Its workshops produced textiles, metalwork and soap for the surrounding villages, while the architecture of the emirs' houses combined local stone building with influences from elsewhere in the Mediterranean.
simp_chinese:
代尔盖迈尔位于黎巴嫩舒夫山地，石砌住宅与宫殿围绕中心广场排列。十六至十八世纪，它是马恩和希哈布家族埃米尔的驻地之一，诸埃米尔在奥斯曼宗主权下统治山区。清真寺、犹太会堂以及基督徒和德鲁兹居民的住宅，反映了城镇社群的多样性。

埃米尔法赫尔丁二世将代尔盖迈尔作为主要驻地之一，十七世纪初在此建造宫殿。与奥斯曼人冲突后，他在托斯卡纳流亡数年，一六一八年返回，最终于一六三五年战败被处决。后来的希哈布统治者也居住于此。镇上作坊为周围村庄生产纺织品、金属器和肥皂；埃米尔住宅的建筑则将地方石工技艺与地中海其他地区的影响结合起来。

english:
Dej stands near the meeting of the Someș rivers in northern Transylvania. Known as Dés in Hungarian, it developed as a royal town closely connected to the salt mines of nearby Ocna Dejului. Salt brought wealth to the crown and work to miners, carriers and merchants; in the Middle Ages rafts carried it down the Someș toward the Pannonian plain.

The town's privileges supported this trade, allowing its inhabitants to move goods and maintain commercial connections beyond the mountains. Salt could also be carried by road toward Zalău and the western plain. Royal concern for the mines shaped the town's legal life: in 1722 the authorities prohibited Jewish residence at Dej, following laws restricting settlement in mining towns. The salt works and river remained central to its fortunes.
simp_chinese:
德日位于特兰西瓦尼亚北部的索梅什河汇流处附近，匈牙利语称代什。它发展为王室城镇，与附近奥克纳德日的盐矿关系密切。盐为王室带来财富，也为矿工、运输者和商人提供生计；中世纪时，盐由木筏沿索梅什河运往潘诺尼亚平原。

城镇特权支持了盐业贸易，使居民能够运输货物，与山外地区保持商业联系。盐也可沿陆路运往扎勒乌及西部平原。王室对矿区的重视同样影响了当地法律生活：1722年，德日当局依据限制在矿镇定居的法律，禁止犹太人在此居住。盐场与河流仍是城镇命运的核心。

english: Dejiang lies in the mountain country northeast of Sinan, home to Tujia and other communities with long traditions of ritual performance. Here masked Nuo ceremonies combine offerings to spirits with music, dance and drama. During the late Ming and early Qing, ritual dances in the wider region absorbed elements of local theatre and developed into Nuo plays performed in ceremonial halls. Carved wooden masks gave form to the gods and characters who appeared before the audience, joining religious observance with stories and performance.
simp_chinese: 德江位于思南东北的山地，是土家等族群长期居住的地方。这里的傩仪以面具、音乐、舞蹈和戏剧结合祭祀。明末清初，广大地区的傩舞吸收地方戏曲形式，发展为在堂屋演出的傩堂戏。木雕面具为神灵和戏中人物赋形，使祭仪与故事、表演融为一体。

english:
Dekemhare is a highland town in Eritrea's Southern Region, southeast of Asmara, in the old province of Akele Guzai. The settlement of Dequ-Mehari, now perched above the town, was founded in the fifteenth century as a small agricultural community. It was overshadowed by the nearby settlement of Gura, which gave its name to the valley.

The surrounding highlands were farmed by Tigrinya-speaking villagers and dotted with churches and monasteries. Not far to the north, near Nefasit, the monastery of Debre Bizen was founded in the 1350s by Filipos on top of a mountain rising to about 2,460 metres, and its library came to hold many Ge'ez manuscripts. A charter of the emperor Zara Yaqob granted lands to the monastery, and in the sixteenth century Ottoman campaigns to establish their province of Habesh damaged it and several other habitations of the region.
simp_chinese:
德克姆哈雷是厄立特里亚南部高原上的一座城镇，位于阿斯马拉东南，属于旧时的阿凯莱古扎伊省。德库—梅哈里聚落如今坐落在城镇上方，建立于15世纪，最初是一个小型农业社群。它曾被邻近的古拉聚落所掩盖，古拉的名字也曾用来称呼这条山谷。

周围的高地由讲提格利尼亚语的村民耕作，教堂和修道院点缀其间。向北不远，在内法西特附近，德布雷比赞修道院于1350年代由菲利波斯创建，位于海拔约2460米的山顶，修道院图书馆后来收藏了许多吉兹语手稿。皇帝扎拉·雅各布曾颁发特许状，把土地授予修道院；16世纪奥斯曼人为建立哈巴什省而发动战争，使它和这一带的其他居住地都受到破坏。

english: The southern Gobi around the Tsetsii hills is a country of dry plains and scattered mountain slopes. Saxaul and other desert shrubs grow where the soil allows, while Mongolian wild asses range across the wider Gobi in search of water and grazing. The open desert links these hills with the basins beyond them.
simp_chinese: 策策山附近的南戈壁由干旱平原和零散山坡组成。梭梭等荒漠灌木在适宜处生长，蒙古野驴则在更广阔的戈壁中寻找水源和草场。开阔荒原将这些山丘与远处盆地连接起来。

english: Lago del Toro lies south of the Paine massif in southern Patagonia, in a basin carved by ancient glaciers. It receives the Paine River and other waters descending from mountains and icefields. At its western end the Serrano River carries the lake’s waters towards the Pacific. Wind, ice and steep mountain slopes shape the surrounding landscape, where open steppe approaches the wetter Andean country.
simp_chinese: 托罗湖位于巴塔哥尼亚南部派内山体以南，湖盆由古代冰川刻蚀形成。派内河及其他从山地和冰原流下的水流汇入湖中。湖西端的塞拉诺河将湖水带向太平洋。风、冰与陡峭山坡塑造周围景观，开阔草原在此接近较湿润的安第斯地区。

english:
Delagoa Bay, then Maputo Bay, is an inlet of the Indian Ocean on the Mozambique coast. It opens toward the northeast, with the spit at Ponta da Macaneta shaping its northwestern end and mangroves behind the western beaches. The Machangulo peninsula protects the eastern side and provides safe anchorage on its inner shore.

Inhaca Island rises beyond the peninsula and adds another sheltering mass between the bay and the open ocean. Several rivers give the harbour its connection with the interior. The Komati enters at the northern end, while the Matola, Umbeluzi and Tembe meet in the western Espírito Santo estuary; the Maputo River reaches the southern shore.

Bars and shallows obstruct navigation, but large vessels can still use the bay throughout the year. Portuguese commander António de Campo reached it in 1502, and merchant Lourenço Marques explored the upper estuaries in 1544. Later Dutch and Austrian traders established factories, showing how coastal access, river routes and uncertain sovereignty combined around this valuable Indian Ocean harbour.
simp_chinese:
德拉戈亚湾即当时的马普托湾，是莫桑比克海岸的一处印度洋海湾。湾口朝东北展开，马卡内塔沙嘴构成西北端，西部海滩背后分布着红树林。马尚古洛半岛护卫东侧，内侧水域可提供安全锚地；再向外的伊尼亚卡岛又增加了海湾与大洋之间的一层屏障。

多条河流使港湾与内陆相连。科马蒂河在北部入湾，马托拉河、翁贝卢齐河与滕贝河在西部圣灵河口相汇，马普托河则抵达南岸。

入口沙洲和湾内浅滩会妨碍航行，但大型船舶在全年仍可利用这一港湾。1502年，葡萄牙船长安东尼奥·德坎波抵达这里；1544年，商人洛伦索·马贵斯又考察了上游河口。此后荷兰与奥地利商人相继建立商站，显示出海岸入口、河运通道和尚未确定的统治权如何在这一印度洋良港周围交织。

english:
Delanglya Bay is a small bay on the western coast of Sakhalin, near the narrowest part of the Strait of Tartary. It faces the mainland across cold, shallow water and lies within a subarctic environment where drift ice forms for much of the year. The bay’s indented shoreline offered shelter from the strait’s winds, but its approaches remained exposed to currents and moving ice.

The surrounding strait connected the Sea of Japan with the Sea of Okhotsk. Its southern entrance seems to narrow and shoal, so early navigators often mistook it for the head of a broad gulf. Local peoples knew the coasts and crossings, while reports reaching Europe remained uncertain. La Pérouse turned south in 1787, William Broughton did the same ten years later, and Adam von Krusenstern failed to force a passage from the north in 1805.

The bay therefore belonged less to an open sea road than to a constrained winter coast. Fishing, hunting and small-boat travel followed the settlements and rivers of western Sakhalin. Larger vessels stayed offshore, keeping the bay a sheltered interlude beside a passage whose northern route remained unproved to European navigators for a long time.
simp_chinese:
德朗利亚湾位于萨哈林岛西岸，靠近鞑靼海峡最狭窄的一段。它隔着寒冷浅水面向大陆，处在一年中长时间形成漂流冰的亚寒带环境里。曲折岸线可以遮蔽海峡来风，进水口却仍暴露于潮流和移动冰体。

周边海峡连接日本海与鄂霍次克海。南口看起来逐渐变窄变浅，早期航海者因此屡次把它误认成宽阔海湾的尽头。本地居民熟悉两岸与渡口，传到欧洲的记述却长期含混。拉彼鲁兹一七八七年转向南行，威廉·布劳顿十年后同样退返，亚当·冯·克鲁森施特恩则在一八〇五年未能从北方强行通过。

海湾因而更像冬季海岸上的避风处，而非开阔海洋通道。渔业、狩猎和小船往来沿萨哈林西部聚落与河流展开，大型船只停留外海。北侧通道对欧洲航海者长期未获证实。

english: Delaram lies on the northern edge of the Dasht-e Margo, in the dry country between Farah and the Helmand valley. Barren hills and gravel plains surround the settlement, while seasonal streams descend from the mountains toward the Sistan basin. Across the desert, water is scarce and habitation is concentrated in river valleys and places where wells or streams make settlement possible.
simp_chinese: 德拉拉姆位于马尔戈荒漠北缘，处在法拉赫与赫尔曼德河谷之间的干旱地带。荒凉的丘陵和砾石平原环绕聚落，季节性河流从山地流向锡斯坦盆地。沙漠中水源稀少，居民主要聚居于河谷和有井水或溪流的地方。

english: Delaware Bay is the wide estuary of the Delaware River, its entrance framed by Cape May and Cape Henlopen. Salt marshes and mudflats line its shores, where river water mingles with the Atlantic. The Lenape lived around the bay before European settlement and called it Poutaxat. Dutch settlers established posts on its shores, while a Swedish colony was founded upriver in 1638. In 1655 a Dutch force under Peter Stuyvesant took control of New Sweden, ending the rival colony's rule along the river.
simp_chinese: 特拉华湾是特拉华河宽阔的河口，入口两侧分别是五月角与亨洛彭角。盐沼和泥滩沿岸分布，河水在此与大西洋海水混合。欧洲人定居之前，莱纳佩人居住在海湾周围，称其为普塔克萨特。荷兰人在湾岸设立据点，瑞典人则于1638年在上游建立殖民地。1655年，彼得·斯泰弗森特率荷兰军队夺取新瑞典，结束了这一竞争殖民地对河流沿岸的统治。

english:
Delémont lies in a broad valley of the Jura, beside the Sorne near its meeting with the Birs. Recorded as Delemonte in 736–737, it passed to the bishop of Basel in 1271. Bishop Peter Reich von Reichenstein granted it a charter in 1289, allowing the town a measure of self-government and the right to distribute land. Walls and four gates enclosed its streets.

The town obtained rights to tax wine and food in 1338 and to sell salt in the valleys of Delémont and Moutier in 1461. A fire destroyed much of it in 1487. During the Reformation, the canons of Moutier-Grandval fled to Delémont, where they used Saint-Marcel as their collegiate church. The bishop's castle was rebuilt as a summer residence in 1716–1721. French revolutionary troops took the town in 1793; after Napoleon's fall it passed to Bern in 1815.
simp_chinese:
德莱蒙位于汝拉山脉的宽阔谷地中，坐落在索尔讷河畔，河流在附近汇入比尔斯河。七三六至七三七年的文献以德莱蒙特之名记载此地；一二七一年，它归巴塞尔主教所有。一二八九年，彼得·赖希·冯·赖兴施泰因主教授予城市宪章，使其拥有一定自治权和分配土地的权利。城墙和四座城门环绕着街道。

一三三八年，城镇取得对葡萄酒和食品征税的权利；一四六一年又获准在德莱蒙和穆捷河谷出售食盐。一四八七年大火毁掉大部分城区。宗教改革期间，穆捷—格朗瓦尔的会士逃到德莱蒙，以圣马塞尔教堂为协同教会。一七一六至一七二一年，主教城堡被重建为夏季驻所。一七九三年法国革命军占领城镇；拿破仑失势后，此地于一八一五年归属伯尔尼。

english: The Delger Mörön, or “wide river”, rises in the Ulaan Taiga range of northern Mongolia. It flows through the mountain and steppe country of Khövsgöl before joining the Ider to form the Selenge. Its waters thus begin a journey that continues north to Lake Baikal. The river is icebound for much of the year, reflecting the long winters of the northern highlands.
simp_chinese: 德勒格尔木伦意为“宽阔的河”，发源于蒙古北部乌兰泰加山。河水流经库苏古尔的山地与草原，与伊德尔河汇合形成色楞格河，开始向北流入贝加尔湖的旅程。河流一年中有很长时间封冻，反映了北方高地漫长的冬季。

english:
Deli lies on the eastern side of northern Sumatra, where rivers descend from the Batak highlands toward the Malacca Strait. Local chiefs and their communities formed a landscape of inland and coastal authority before the rise of the Malay sultanate. Deli's rulers drew upon alliances with these leaders as well as connections across the strait and with Aceh to the north.

In the seventeenth century Gocah Pahlawan, associated with Sultan Iskandar Muda of Aceh, established a ruling line in Deli. His marriage into a local chiefly family helped bind the new court to the surrounding communities. His successor Perunggit asserted a more independent position as Aceh's power weakened. In the early eighteenth century a dispute over succession led to the emergence of neighboring Serdang as a separate polity.
simp_chinese:
德利位于苏门答腊北部东侧，河流从巴塔克高地流向马六甲海峡。马来苏丹国兴起之前，地方首领及其社群已构成内陆与沿海交织的权力格局。德利统治者既依靠与这些首领的联盟，也与海峡对岸和北方的亚齐保持联系。

十七世纪，与亚齐苏丹依斯干达·穆达有关的戈查·巴拉万在德利建立统治世系。他与当地首领家族的联姻帮助新宫廷同周围社群结成纽带。随着亚齐势力减弱，继承者佩隆吉特争取更独立的地位。十八世纪初，一场继承争端促使邻近的沙登成为独立政权。

english: Delijan lies in the uplands between Qom and Isfahan, where roads cross the central Iranian plateau. Nearby Dudehak preserves a caravanserai of the Safavid period, built to shelter travellers and their animals along the route. Its enclosed courtyard and strong walls reflect the practical needs of journeys between towns across dry and mountainous country. The building belongs to a wider network of roadside inns developed under the Safavids, when movement through the plateau linked the capital with other regions of Iran.
simp_chinese: 德利詹位于库姆与伊斯法罕之间的高地，多条道路穿越伊朗中部高原。附近的杜德哈克保存着一座萨法维时期的商队旅舍，供沿途旅人及牲畜休憩。围合庭院和坚固墙壁反映了城镇之间穿越干旱山地的实际需要。这座建筑属于萨法维时代发展的道路旅舍网络，当时高原交通将首都与伊朗其他地区连接起来。

english: Deliktaş lies among the uplands south of Sivas, near the road through Kangal. Its Turkish name means “pierced stone”, recalling the rocky landscape of the district. The settlement stood in a high country of valleys and pasture, where routes linked Sivas with the lands to the south. Ottoman records later knew the place as a mountain passage, a reminder of the importance of such routes through the hills.
simp_chinese: 德利克塔什位于锡瓦斯以南的高地，靠近经过坎加尔的道路。土耳其语地名意为“穿孔石”，令人想起当地多岩的地貌。聚落坐落在河谷与牧场相间的高地，道路将锡瓦斯与南方地区连接起来。奥斯曼文献后来将它称作山口，反映出穿越群山的路线具有重要意义。

english: The Delinde is a river in western Yakutia’s Vilyuy basin. It descends through the northern forest country to join the Vilyuy, a major tributary of the Lena. River valleys cut across the plateau, and the long winter freeze gives way to a short season of flowing water when snow and ice melt across the basin.
simp_chinese: 杰林德河位于雅库特西部维柳伊流域，穿过北方森林地带汇入维柳伊河；后者是勒拿河的重要支流。河谷切穿高原，漫长冬季的冰封之后，流域冰雪融化，河流进入短暂的流水季节。

english:
Délı̨nę faces the western shore of Great Bear Lake in the Sahtu Region, at the point where the lake narrows into the Great Bear River. Its North Slavey name means “where the waters flow,” joining the lake to the Mackenzie system. Wetlands, spruce forest and rocky shores surround the settlement under a climate of short cool summers and severe dry winters.

Sahtu Dene families used the lake through fishing, hunting and seasonal camps long before European traders arrived. Whitefish and trout runs supplied food for preservation, and caribou and other game provided meat, hides and tools. Barren-ground caribou and lake fish remain visible in stories; names for islands, bays, caribou crossings and camps record a dense map of use and memory.

Fort Franklin was built beside the western shore in 1825 during Franklin’s Arctic expedition, close to an important Dene fishery. Archaeological traces of beads, rings and buttons illustrate early contact exchange between local families and explorers. The post drew seasonal gatherings without replacing the older camps, and fishing, travel and kinship continued to organize life on Great Bear Lake. Fishing knowledge shaped where camps could remain.
simp_chinese:
德利内面向大熊湖西岸，位于萨赫图地区湖泊收窄为大熊河之处。北斯拉维语名称意为“水流之处”，把湖泊同马更些水系连接起来。湿地、云杉林和岩石岸线环绕聚落，当地夏季短而凉爽，冬季严寒干燥。

早在欧洲商人到来以前，萨赫图德内人的家庭就通过捕鱼、狩猎和季节营地利用大熊湖。白鱼与鳟鱼汛提供可保存的食物，驯鹿等猎物提供肉、兽皮和制具材料。湖中岛屿、海湾、驯鹿渡口与营地的名称，记录着一幅密集利用与记忆形成的地图。

一八二五年，富兰克林北极远征在湖西岸建立富兰克林堡，位置靠近德内人重要渔场。考古发现的珠子、戒指和纽扣展示了当地家庭与探险者之间的早期接触交换。商站带来季节聚集，却没有替代旧营地；捕鱼、出行和亲族关系继续组织大熊湖畔生活。捕鱼知识决定哪些营地能够长期维持。湖岸地名也保存航行情报。

english: Delitzsch lies north of Leipzig on the Lober. Its name is of Slavic origin, and the settlement was first documented in 1166. A town developed around 1200, protected by walls and towers, with a castle that later served Saxon rulers as a residence. During the Thirty Years' War the town faced Swedish forces; a local tradition tells how a tower watchman's daughter sounded a warning as they approached. After the Congress of Vienna in 1815, Delitzsch passed from Saxony to Prussia.
simp_chinese: 代利奇位于莱比锡以北的洛伯河畔，地名源自斯拉夫语，聚落于1166年首次见诸文献。约1200年，城镇逐渐形成，城墙和塔楼保护着居民，城堡后来成为萨克森统治者的驻地。三十年战争期间，城市面对瑞典军；当地传说讲述守塔人的女儿在敌军接近时吹响号角示警。1815年维也纳会议后，代利奇由萨克森转归普鲁士。

english:
Delmenhorst lies in flat, wet country west of Bremen, beside the small river Delme. Marshes and grassland spread toward the Weser lowlands, while slightly higher ground supported roads, fields and a castle. The nearby commercial city of Bremen shaped trade, but the boundary between competing lordships also gave the site independent value.

In 1234 the Count of Oldenburg acquired the place by the Delme, and a castle was established around 1247 to protect a new settlement. The castle became a residence of the counts, and Delmenhorst received town rights under Bremen law in 1371. Control passed at times to the bishop of Bremen, while Count Gerhard VI used the castle as a base for robber-baronage until a siege ended his influence in 1482.

The town developed as a small market and administrative center among pastures and waterways. Cattle, grain, peat and river transport supplied its households, while the castle and town wall marked the authority of Oldenburg. Delmenhorst’s history remained tied to the marshy approach to Bremen and to the competition between nearby lords rather than to a large port of its own. Peat cutting and cattle rearing spread across its wet hinterland.
simp_chinese:
代尔门霍斯特位于不来梅以西低湿平原，紧邻代尔梅小河。沼泽与草地向威悉河低地铺展，略高地面上分布道路、田地与城堡。附近不来梅的商业影响塑造贸易，竞争中的领主边界又赋予此地独立价值。

一二三四年，奥尔登堡伯爵取得代尔梅河畔地点，约一二四七年建立城堡以保护新聚落。城堡后来成为伯爵居所，代尔门霍斯特一三七一年依不来梅法获得城市权。控制权一度转入不来梅主教，格哈德六世伯爵又利用城堡从事强盗式统治，直到一四八二年围城终结其势力。

城镇在牧场与水道之间发展为小型市场及行政中心。牛、谷物、泥炭与河运供应居民，城堡和城墙标示奥尔登堡权威。代尔门霍斯特的历史始终同通向不来梅的沼泽边缘以及邻近领主竞争相连，并未发展为自身的大型港口。泥炭采挖和养牛活动分布在全城湿地腹地，为家庭提供燃料与收入。道路连接村落。

english: On the southeastern slopes of Mount Londiani, Deloraine lies in the high country of Kenya's Rift Valley. The ground here holds traces of communities who lived through successive phases of the Iron Age. An early settlement at Deloraine is among the oldest known Iron Age sites in the central Rift. Nearby are later Sirikwa hollows, sunken enclosures associated with the pastoral societies that occupied parts of the highlands during the second millennium.
simp_chinese: 德洛雷恩位于肯尼亚裂谷高地，坐落在隆迪亚尼山的东南坡。这里的土地保存着不同时期铁器时代居民的遗迹。德洛雷恩的早期聚落是中央裂谷已知最古老的铁器时代遗址之一；附近还有年代较晚的西里夸凹地。这些下凹的围场与第二个千年间活动于部分高地的牧民社会有关。

english: Deloy Chet lies in the lower Yukon country near the Innoko River, amid a network of channels and lowlands. It is a place associated with both Deg Hit’an and Yup’ik communities, close to the meeting of their territories. The waterways of the Innoko lowlands provided access to fishing grounds and connected neighbouring settlements. In the country between the Yukon and Kuskokwim, lakes and streams also offered routes across the divide, sometimes allowing travel by canoe when the water was high.
simp_chinese: 德洛伊切特位于育空河下游地区，靠近伊诺科河，周围是河道交织的低地。这里与德格希坦人和尤皮克人的社群都有关联，接近两者土地的交界。伊诺科低地的水道通向渔场，也连接相邻聚落。育空河与库斯科奎姆河之间的湖泊和溪流提供了跨越分水岭的路线，水位高时有些路段甚至可以乘独木舟通过。

english: Deloy Ges is a hillside above the meeting of the Anvik and Yukon rivers, in the homeland of the Deg Hit’an. The name also identifies the nearby community of Anvik, whose older village sites lay beside the river. A Deg Xinag story tells how Raven piled up sand to make a mountain. When the sand slipped beneath him, he struck it with his walking stick, making the gullies that mark the hillside. The river junction and its prominent bluff remain landmarks in the traditional landscape of the lower Yukon.
simp_chinese: 德洛伊格斯是一处山坡，俯瞰安维克河与育空河的交汇处，位于德格希坦人的家园。这个名字也用于附近的安维克社群，其旧村址坐落在河边。德格希纳格人的故事说，渡鸦堆起沙子造山，沙土却在他脚下滑落；他用手杖愤怒地抽打沙堆，形成了山坡上的道道沟壑。河流交汇处和突出的崖坡，是育空河下游传统地景中的重要标记。

english:
Deltana lies near the confluence of the Tanana and Delta rivers in Alaska’s interior, on broad flats between wooded ridges and the Alaska Range. Rivers braid across gravel and wetlands, providing fish, transport and the main corridors through a landscape of severe winter cold. Moose, caribou and smaller game supplemented fish and plant foods gathered along the margins.

Tanana Athabaskan families used the river country through seasonal camps and winter settlements. Fish wheels and weirs were placed at productive channels, while trails followed frozen rivers and ridge lines. Kinship linked bands across the Tanana basin, and place names recorded fishing sites, crossings and hunting grounds. Travel depended on careful reading of breakup, freeze-up and snow conditions.

The confluence later became a meeting point for travelers and traders entering the northern interior. Roadhouses and military roads added new routes, but the older river geography remained. Deltana’s identity belongs to the Athabaskan world of fish camps and winter trails, where two rivers created a natural interchange across interior Alaska. Fish camps moved with spring breakup.
simp_chinese:
德尔塔纳位于阿拉斯加内陆塔纳纳河与德尔塔河汇合处附近，处在林脊与阿拉斯加山脉之间的宽阔平地。河流在砾石和湿地间分汊，提供鱼类、运输手段以及穿越严寒冬季地区的主要走廊。驼鹿、驯鹿和小型猎物补充沿岸采集的植物食物。

塔纳纳阿萨巴斯卡家庭通过季节营地和冬村利用河乡。人们在高产水道设置鱼轮和鱼堰，道路沿封冻河流与山脊延伸。亲缘关系连接塔纳纳流域各群体，地名记录渔点、渡口与猎场。出行依赖对开河、封冻和雪况的细致判断。

汇流处后来成为进入北方内陆的旅人与商人会合点。路边旅店和军用道路增加新路线，较早的河流地理仍支配当地。德尔塔纳的身份属于阿萨巴斯卡人的鱼营与冬季小径世界，两条河在这里形成横越阿拉斯加内陆的天然立交。鱼营也随春季开河而迁移。冬季道路连接营地。鱼营随水迁移。

english:
Delyankir lies in the mountains of the upper Indigirka basin in northeastern Siberia, on a plateau of larch forest and frozen ground close to the divide with the Kolyma country. Its setting is one of the coldest in the northern hemisphere, shared with famous cold poles such as Oymyakon and Verkhoyansk. Winters are long, dry and exceptionally severe, with temperatures that can fall below minus 50 degrees Celsius; summers are short and generally mild despite very white nights, though short bursts of heat can push temperatures surprisingly high.

The land was the range of Even reindeer herders and hunters and of Yakut horse and cattle breeders, who moved between winter camps and summer pastures along the mountain rivers. Larch forest supplied wood, sable and other fur animals supplied the main trade goods, and permafrost kept the ground frozen below a thin summer thaw. From the 1630s Cossack parties reached the Indigirka and the Kolyma and collected fur tribute from the local peoples, but the upland valleys near the headwaters stayed thinly peopled, a region of sparse camps and long winter distances.
simp_chinese:
杰良基尔位于西伯利亚东北部因迪吉尔卡河上游流域的山地，在落叶松林和冻土构成的高原上，靠近与科雷马地区的分水岭。这里属于北半球最寒冷的地区之一，与奥伊米亚康、维尔霍扬斯克等著名寒极共享极端环境。冬季漫长、干燥而酷寒，气温可降至零下50摄氏度以下；夏季虽会经历白夜，通常仍短暂温和，偶有短时高温则显得格外突然。

这片土地是埃文人驯鹿牧民和猎人、以及雅库特人马牛饲养者的活动范围，他们沿山区河流在冬营地和夏季牧场之间迁移。落叶松林提供木材，紫貂等毛皮兽提供主要的贸易物品，永久冻土在短暂的夏季融化层之下始终冻结。自十七世纪三十年代起，哥萨克队伍抵达因迪吉尔卡河和科雷马河，向当地民族征收毛皮贡赋，但河源附近的高地谷地仍然人烟稀少，只有零散营地，冬季路途遥远。

english:
Demak was a port on the north coast of Java and the centre of one of the island's earliest Muslim kingdoms. Its Great Mosque, traditionally associated with the Wali Songo, or Nine Saints, stands as a monument to the spread of Islam in Java. From this coastal town, rulers once held sway over other ports and sent fleets across the Java Sea.

Tradition credits Raden Patah, connected by descent to the royal house of Majapahit, with founding the sultanate in the late fifteenth century. Muslim merchants and teachers had already established communities on the north coast, and Demak grew as Majapahit's authority weakened. Its ruler Pati Unus led expeditions against Portuguese Malacca in 1513 and 1521, but failed to take the port. Under Trenggana, Demak's influence extended along Java; forces associated with his reign took Sunda Kelapa in 1527. His death during a campaign in eastern Java in 1546 was followed by a struggle over succession. Power eventually passed to Hadiwijaya of Pajang, who moved the royal regalia inland, leaving Demak subordinate to his new court.
simp_chinese:
淡目曾是爪哇北岸的港口，也是岛上最早的穆斯林王国之一的中心。淡目大清真寺传统上与传播伊斯兰教的“九圣”相联系，是这一宗教在爪哇传播的见证。统治者从这座海港城镇支配其他港口，并派遣舰队穿越爪哇海。

传说认为，与满者伯夷王室有血缘关系的拉登·帕塔于十五世纪末创立苏丹国。穆斯林商人与教师此前已在北岸建立社群，随着满者伯夷权威衰落，淡目逐渐兴起。其统治者帕蒂·乌努斯于1513年和1521年两度率军进攻葡萄牙人占领的马六甲，却未能夺取港口。特伦加纳统治时，淡目的影响沿爪哇扩展；与其统治有关的军队于1527年夺取巽他格拉巴。1546年他在东爪哇征战时身亡，随后爆发继承争斗。权力最终落入巴章的哈迪维查亚手中，他将王室信物迁往内陆，使淡目从属于新的王廷。

english:
The Demanda Range belongs to the high interior of the Iberian Peninsula, a compact southwestern European landmass separated from France by the Pyrenees. Spain occupies most of the peninsula, with Portugal along the Atlantic west and a small strip of France beyond the northern mountains. Inland Castile rises into broad plateaus crossed by mountain chains, where cool continental winters, strong winds and thin soils make settlement concentrate in valleys and sheltered basins. The ridges also separate drainage systems and slow movement between the meseta and the Ebro and Duero lowlands.

The peninsula has long been a meeting ground. Iberian, Celtic and other peoples occupied it before Carthaginian and Roman expansion. Rome organized the territory as Hispania and divided it into provinces, while roads, towns, Latin speech and agricultural estates reshaped large regions. After the western empire, Visigothic rule, Islamic al-Andalus and the gradual expansion of Christian kingdoms layered different systems of landholding, religion and urban life over the same mountain and plateau country.

For the Demanda Range, this wider history explains the importance of high passes and isolated pasture. Movement must follow gaps between ridges, and communities on either side maintain separate routes to markets and lowland fields. The range is thus a barrier, a shared produce and part of the larger frontier landscape of northern Iberia.
simp_chinese:
德曼达山脉位于伊比利亚半岛内陆高地。伊比利亚是欧洲西南部相对封闭的陆地，北部以比利牛斯山与法国相隔；西班牙占据半岛大部分，葡萄牙沿大西洋西岸延伸，法国则在北侧山地外拥有狭小地带。内陆卡斯蒂利亚由宽广高原和横向山链组成，冬季寒冷，风力强劲，土壤较薄，聚落因而集中在谷地和避风盆地。山脊也分隔水系，使梅塞塔高原与埃布罗、杜罗低地之间的往来变慢。

半岛长期是多种力量交汇之地。伊比利亚人、凯尔特人及其他族群先在此生活，迦太基和罗马随后扩张；罗马把整个地区称为伊斯帕尼亚并划分行省，道路、城镇、拉丁语和农业庄园改变了大片区域。西罗马帝国崩溃后，西哥特统治、伊斯兰安达卢斯以及基督教诸王国的推进，又在同样的山地与高原上叠加了不同的土地制度、宗教和城市生活。

对德曼达山脉而言，更广阔的历史解释了高山隘口和隔离牧场的重要性。道路必须利用山脊间的缺口，两侧社群也各自保持通往市场和低地的路线。山脉因而兼具阻隔、共享资源与伊比利亚北部边疆景观三重作用。

english: Demba lies in Kisama, the country between the Kwanza and Longa rivers on Angola's Atlantic side. The region's local rulers, or sobas, defended their lands against Portuguese incursions. In 1580 Kisama leaders tried to stop a Portuguese expedition passing near the Kwanza, and a fierce battle followed. Their successors continued to resist colonial expansion in the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries, sometimes interrupting the land connection between Luanda and Benguela.
simp_chinese: 登巴位于基萨马，这片土地处在安哥拉大西洋一侧的宽扎河与隆加河之间。当地统治者称为索巴，他们保卫自己的领地，抵抗葡萄牙入侵。1580年，基萨马诸首领试图阻止一支葡萄牙远征军在宽扎河附近通行，双方随即爆发激战。十七至十八世纪，他们的继承者继续抵抗殖民扩张，有时切断罗安达与本格拉之间的陆路联系。

english: Dembimbosaage, a Shoshoni name meaning “stone bridge”, lies on the upper Snake River. Here the river descends across the broad volcanic plain, on its long journey westward towards the Columbia. The falls and rapids along its course marked a landscape known to Shoshone and Bannock communities, who drew upon the river and the surrounding country for food. Salmon once travelled far up the Snake, making its waters important fishing grounds as well as a route through the interior.
simp_chinese: 登宾博萨格是一个肖肖尼语地名，意为“石桥”，位于斯内克河上游。河水在此流过宽阔的火山平原，向西奔行，最终汇入哥伦比亚河。沿途的瀑布与急流是肖肖尼人和班诺克人熟悉的景观；他们从河流与周围地区获取食物。鲑鱼曾远溯斯内克河上游，使这条河既是内陆交通线，也提供重要的渔场。

english: Demensk lies in the wooded uplands between the Dnieper and Oka basins. The Demena district appears in the Lithuanian records of 1446 among lands granted by Grand Duke Casimir to Prince Fyodor Vorotynsky. Under the truce of 1503 it passed to Moscow, and Ivan III later left it to his son Yuri. The village of Spasskoye belonged to the Demena palace district in the late seventeenth and early eighteenth centuries.
simp_chinese: 杰缅斯克位于第聂伯河与奥卡河流域之间森林覆盖的高地。1446年的立陶宛文书将杰梅纳地区列为大公卡齐米日赐予费奥多尔·沃罗滕斯基亲王的领地。1503年停战协定将其划归莫斯科，伊凡三世后来将它留给儿子尤里。17世纪末至18世纪初，斯帕斯科耶村属于杰梅纳宫廷乡区。

english: Demerara grew along the lower river of the same name on the Guiana coast. The Dutch opened the district to plantation settlement in 1745, separating it from Essequibo. In 1755 the administration moved to Borsselen, an island some thirty kilometres upriver, near the plantation of Governor Laurens Storm van ’s Gravesande. The settlement at the river mouth later became Stabroek and replaced Borsselen as the colonial capital in 1782.
simp_chinese: 德梅拉拉沿圭亚那海岸同名河流的下游发展。1745年，荷兰人开放该地区建立种植园，并将其从埃塞奎博分出。1755年，殖民行政机关迁到上游约三十公里的博尔瑟伦岛，岛屿靠近总督劳伦斯·斯托姆·范斯赫拉弗桑德的种植园。河口的聚落后来称为斯塔布鲁克，1782年取代博尔瑟伦成为殖民地首府。

english:
The Demerara coast opens along the northern shore of the Guianas, where the lower Demerara River reaches the Atlantic through a broad tropical lowland. This was the historic core of Demerara, whose main settlement later became Georgetown. The name comes from a Lokono expression meaning the “river of the letter wood,” connecting the place to the forests that supplied that material.

Demerara first appears in records as a trading post in 1691. The Dutch West India Company governed it from 1745, and the Dutch state held it from 1792 until British power became permanent in 1815. Settlement concentrated around the river mouth and grew rapidly as English planters entered the colony; by 1780 it had nearly two hundred plantations. The economy depended heavily on enslaved labour, and revolts shaped its history.

A major revolt broke out in West Demerara in 1795, and another spread along the East Coast in 1823. Both were suppressed with bloodshed, yet they became part of the long struggle that contributed to the end of slavery. Demerara was joined with Essequibo in 1812 and with Berbice in 1831 to create British Guiana. Coast, river, plantation labour and Atlantic trade made this low shoreline a crossroads of migration and conflict.
simp_chinese:
德梅拉拉海岸沿着圭亚那北岸展开，德梅拉拉河下游穿过炎热低地，在这里注入大西洋。这一带是历史地区德梅拉拉的核心，主要聚落后来发展为乔治敦。地名的洛科诺语由来意为“书信木之河”，把地方与出产这种木材的森林联系起来。

德梅拉拉在文献中最早以1691年的贸易站出现。荷兰西印度公司从1745年起管理此地；1792年以后转归荷兰国家，直到英国在1815年正式确立统治。人口与开发集中在河口附近，随着英国种植者进入而迅速扩展，到1780年已有近两百座种植园。当地经济严重依赖被奴役者的劳动，暴力反抗也不断改变历史。

1795年，西德梅拉拉爆发大规模起义；1823年，东海岸又发生起义。两次都遭到血腥镇压，却成为争取结束奴隶制度长期斗争的一部分。德梅拉拉1812年与埃塞奎博合并，1831年再与伯比斯合组英属圭亚那。海岸、河口、种植园劳动与大西洋贸易，使这片低平水岸成为迁徙和冲突交汇之地。

english:
Demetrias stands at the head of the Pagasaean Gulf in eastern Thessaly. Founded in 294 BC by Demetrius Poliorcetes, who gathered the inhabitants of several neighbouring settlements into his new city, it became a favoured residence of Macedonian kings. Philip V counted it with Chalcis and Corinth among the three strongholds that served as the fetters of Greece, commanding both the Thessalian interior and the sea.

The city endured into the Byzantine and Frankish eras, though its fortunes had changed. In the 1270s a Byzantine fleet defeated Venetian and Lombard opponents in the nearby battle of Demetrias. The Catalan Company sacked the town in 1310 and held it for much of the fourteenth century. From 1333 its inhabitants began to move towards neighbouring Volos; the Ottomans captured Demetrias in 1393.
simp_chinese:
德米特里亚斯位于色萨利东部帕加西蒂科斯湾的尽头。德米特里一世于公元前294年建城，将附近数个聚落的居民迁入新城；此后它成为马其顿国王喜爱的驻地。腓力五世把它与哈尔基斯、科林斯并称为控制希腊的三处“锁链”，因为它既能扼制色萨利内陆，也能控制海上通路。

城市延续至拜占庭和法兰克时代，但命运已多次改变。十三世纪七十年代，拜占庭舰队在附近的德米特里亚斯海战中击败威尼斯及伦巴第对手。加泰罗尼亚佣兵团于1310年洗劫城镇，并在十四世纪的大部分时间控制这里。从1333年起，居民开始迁向邻近的沃洛斯；1393年奥斯曼人占领了德米特里亚斯。

english:
Porechye, later called Demidov, stands where the Gobza joins the Kasplya north of Smolensk. The Kasplya flows to the Western Dvina and offered a route toward Riga and the Baltic. First mentioned in 1499, the settlement developed as a river landing and a centre for the surrounding forests and fields.

After the Truce of Andrusovo in 1667, the Porechye district was granted to the diplomat Afanasy Ordin-Nashchokin. Peter I established a trading landing here in the early eighteenth century. Boats carried timber, grain, hemp and other goods down the Kasplya and Western Dvina to Riga. Catherine II made Porechye a district town in 1776; three years later records counted dozens of river vessels departing for Riga, evidence of the importance of its waterborne trade.
simp_chinese:
波列奇耶后来称为杰米多夫，位于斯摩棱斯克以北戈布扎河注入卡斯普利亚河处。卡斯普利亚河流入西德维纳河，提供通往里加及波罗的海的道路。聚落首次见于1499年的记载，后来发展为河港和周围森林、农田地区的中心。

1667年安德鲁索沃停战协定签订后，波列奇耶地区赐给外交官阿法纳西·奥尔丁－纳晓金。18世纪初，彼得一世在此设立商港。船只沿卡斯普利亚河和西德维纳河将木材、谷物、大麻等货物运往里加。叶卡捷琳娜二世于1776年将波列奇耶升为县城；三年后，记录中已有数十艘河船从此驶向里加，显示水运贸易的重要性。

english: Demirci lies in the uplands of western Anatolia, in the old Saruhan country. Ruled by the Saruhanid beys in the fourteenth century, it passed into Ottoman hands in the early fifteenth and became the centre of a district. Sixteenth-century Ottoman registers record thirteen neighbourhoods in the town, alongside a rural district of many villages. Grain cultivation, livestock and mills supported the surrounding communities.
simp_chinese: 代米尔吉位于安纳托利亚西部高地，属于旧时的萨鲁汗地区。十四世纪它由萨鲁汗贝伊家族统治，十五世纪初转入奥斯曼之手，成为一个辖区的中心。十六世纪奥斯曼登记册记载城中有十三个街区，周围乡区则有众多村庄。谷物种植、畜牧和磨坊维持着附近社群的生活。

english:
Demmin grew at a crossing of rivers and roads in western Pomerania. Its strongholds guarded the lands of the Slavic Circipanians, and Bishop Otto of Bamberg visited in 1127 during the Christianization of the region. The town became the seat of a small duchy in 1160 and was reunited with Pomerania in 1264. Its municipal privileges were confirmed in 1292.

The partition of Pomerania in 1295 divided authority here: the town went to the dukes of Wolgast, while the castle passed to the dukes of Szczecin. In 1326 Duke Otto I exempted all merchants coming to the town of Demmin from local customs and taxes. Mecklenburg besieged the town unsuccessfully in 1327 during the War of the Rügen Succession. From 1478 Demmin belonged to the reunified Duchy of Pomerania.
simp_chinese:
代明兴起于西波美拉尼亚河流与道路的交汇处，其堡垒守卫着斯拉夫西尔齐帕尼人的土地。1127年，班贝格主教奥托在当地基督教化期间到访。1160年，城镇成为一个小公国的驻地，1264年重新并入波美拉尼亚，城市特权又于1292年得到确认。

1295年波美拉尼亚分封使此地的统治权分开：城镇归沃尔加斯特公爵，城堡则归什切青公爵。1326年，公爵奥托一世免除了前来代明的商人在当地的关税和税款。1327年吕根继承战争期间，梅克伦堡围攻城市未果。1478年起，代明属于重新统一的波美拉尼亚公国。

english: Demnate stands at the foot of the High Atlas east of Marrakech, between the mountains and the plains of central Morocco. It was home to a substantial Jewish community, whose presence is recorded from the twelfth century. The town’s mellah and markets belonged to a wider network of settlements in the Atlas, where Jews and Muslims lived among the mountain communities and exchanged goods.
simp_chinese: 代姆纳特位于马拉喀什以东的大阿特拉斯山麓，地处山区与摩洛哥中部平原之间。这里曾有规模可观的犹太社区，十二世纪已有其存在的记载。城镇的犹太街区和市场属于阿特拉斯山更广阔的聚落网络；犹太人与穆斯林居住在山地社区中，彼此交换货物。

english:
Demon stood on the Yavon River in Novgorod's Derevskaya Pyatina, amid lakes and forest routes. Its fortress protected a waterway from Lake Ilmen along the Pola and Yavon toward Lake Seliger, as well as approaches to Novgorod from the east.

Recorded in medieval Novgorodian sources, Demon lay near lands contested by Novgorod, Moscow and Lithuania. Muscovite forces failed to take it in 1441 but destroyed the fortress in the 1470s. After Novgorod fell to Moscow, the old stronghold lost its frontier role. A later settlement nearby became known as Demyansky Pogost, the predecessor of Demyansk.
simp_chinese:
杰蒙位于诺夫哥罗德杰列夫斯卡亚地区的亚翁河畔，周围分布着湖泊和林间道路。其堡垒守护着从伊尔门湖沿波拉河、亚翁河通往谢利格尔湖的水路，也守护着从东面通向诺夫哥罗德的道路。

杰蒙见于中世纪诺夫哥罗德史料，地处诺夫哥罗德、莫斯科和立陶宛争夺的地区附近。莫斯科军队1441年未能攻下这里，却在1470年代摧毁了堡垒。诺夫哥罗德归莫斯科后，旧要塞失去了边境防御的作用。附近后来的聚落称为杰米扬斯基教堂村，是杰米扬斯克的前身。

english:
Demótica, known to the Greeks as Didymoteichon and to the Ottomans as Dimetoka, stands near the Hebrus in Thrace. Its name means “twin wall,” recalling the fortifications that guarded a town of considerable importance to Byzantine emperors. Below the hilltop citadel, the great mosque of Çelebi Sultan Mehmed bears witness to its later Ottoman rulers.

In October 1341 John Kantakouzenos was proclaimed emperor at Didymoteichon, beginning a bitter civil war against the regency of John V Palaiologos. The town served as his headquarters during the struggle. After the Ottoman conquest, it continued to attract imperial patronage. Sultan Mehmed I ordered the construction of a large mosque whose entrance inscription records the year 1420. Its monumental prayer hall and timber roof made it one of the most imposing buildings of the early Ottoman town.
simp_chinese:
迪莫蒂卡位于色雷斯赫布罗斯河附近，希腊人称其为季季莫蒂洪，奥斯曼人称其为季梅托卡。希腊语名称意为“双墙”，让人想起守护这座城镇的防御工事；它曾是拜占庭皇帝重视的据点。山顶城堡下方，切莱比苏丹穆罕默德大清真寺则见证了后来的奥斯曼统治。

1341年10月，约翰·坎塔库泽努斯在季季莫蒂洪被拥立为皇帝，由此开始了与约翰五世·巴列奥略摄政政府之间的激烈内战。城镇在斗争中成为他的总部。奥斯曼征服后，这里继续受到统治者赞助。苏丹穆罕默德一下令修建一座大型清真寺，入口铭文记载的日期是1420年。宏伟的礼拜大厅与木屋顶，使它成为早期奥斯曼城镇最壮观的建筑之一。

english: Demyanovo is a village in the forested country north of Buy. It is first recorded in 1628, as are several neighboring villages, including Putilovo, Orlovo and Bogdanovo. The Church of Saint Basil the Great was built in stone in 1820 with funds from parishioners and served a community that extended beyond Demyanovo itself. The parish belonged to the Buy district of the Kostroma diocese, linking these scattered settlements to the ecclesiastical life of the wider region.
simp_chinese: 杰米亚诺沃位于布伊以北的林地。它最早见于1628年的记载，附近的普季洛沃、奥尔洛沃和博格丹诺沃等村庄也在同年出现于记录中。1820年，教区居民出资建造了石造圣瓦西里大帝教堂，服务的社群不止杰米亚诺沃一村。这个教区属于科斯特罗马教区的布伊辖区，将分散的村庄与更广地区的教会生活联系起来。

english:
Dën-Terek belongs to the upper Yenisei country of Tuva, a southern Siberian republic positioned near the geographical center of Asia. The wider territory shares borders with Mongolia and several Russian regions, and its landscapes join the forested and steppe worlds of southern Siberia. Medieval Tuva passed through the control of successive Chinese dynasties and nomadic khanates, so its political history was shaped by movement across Inner Asian frontiers rather than by a single settled core.

In 1758 the territory entered the Qing realm as Tannu Uriankhai, within Outer Mongolia. Kyzyl later became the capital and at that time contains more than a third of the republic’s population.

Tuvans form the largest ethnic group, speak Tuvan, and share the republic with a Russian minority; both languages are official. Around the small place name of Dën-Terek, therefore, lies a much larger story of pastoral mobility, imperial competition and the making of a later republic at the meeting point of Siberia and Mongolia. Routes endured. Mountain routes sustained trade.
simp_chinese:
登特勒克属于图瓦的叶尼塞河上游地区。图瓦是南西伯利亚的一个共和国，接近亚洲地理中心，并与蒙古及数个俄罗斯地区接壤，其景观连接南西伯利亚的森林与草原世界。中世纪的图瓦先后受多个中国王朝和游牧汗国控制，因此当地政治史主要由跨内亚边疆的人员与权力流动塑造，而非围绕单一定居核心展开。

1758年，这一地区以外蒙古唐努乌梁海的名义进入清朝版图。克孜勒后来成为首都，当时居住着共和国三分之一以上的人口。

图瓦人构成最大族群，使用图瓦语，并与俄罗斯族少数群体共同生活；两种语言均为官方语言。围绕登特勒克这个小地名展开的，是游牧迁徙、帝国竞争以及西伯利亚与蒙古交界处后世共和国形成的大历史。山地道路维系贸易。

english:
These uplands form part of the Dena’ina homeland in south-central Alaska, a territory extending from Seldovia and Pedro Bay toward Chickaloon, Talkeetna and Lime Village. Covering more than 41,000 square miles, it includes inland valleys, waterways and coastal approaches. The Dena’ina are an Alaska Native Athabaskan people who came into this region sometime between 1,000 and 1,500 years ago.

They were the only Alaskan Athabaskan group to live along the coast, and their hunter-gatherer culture drew on both marine and inland produce. Society followed matrilineal descent, while travel and seasonal work linked settlements across a broad country rather than confining them to one permanent center.

The routes later associated with the Iditarod Trail grew from Native trails used by the Dena’ina, Deg Hit’an and Inupiaq, showing that knowledge of passes, rivers and winter travel had regional importance. Neighboring Athabaskan and Yupik peoples occupied lands in several directions, making these uplands one part of a wider network of exchange and kinship. For a terrain defined by difficult travel, the history of the country lies in how communities understood and connected highland paths, inland hunting grounds and the coastal edge.
simp_chinese:
这些高地位于阿拉斯加中南部的德纳伊纳人故土，范围从南面的塞尔多维亚、佩德罗湾延伸到东北的奇卡隆，以及北面的塔尔基特纳和西北的莱姆村。故土面积超过41000平方英里，包含内陆谷地、水道和通往海岸的地区。德纳伊纳人是阿拉斯加原住民中的阿萨巴斯卡语族民族，大约在1000年至1500年前进入这一区域。

他们是阿拉斯加阿萨巴斯卡族群中唯一生活在沿海的一支，狩猎采集文化同时利用海洋与内陆资源。社会沿母系传承，旅行和季节性劳作把广阔地域中的聚落连接起来，而非将人们局限于单一永久中心。

后来与艾迪塔罗德步道相联系的道路，源自德纳伊纳人、德格希坦人和因纽皮雅特人的传统小径，说明对山口、河流和冬季道路的知识具有区域意义。邻近的阿萨巴斯卡与尤皮克民族分布在不同方向，使这些高地成为交换与亲属网络的一部分。对这片交通艰难的土地而言，其历史正在于社群如何理解并连接高地路径、内陆猎场与海岸边缘。

english: Denali rises above the Alaska Range, its great snow-covered mass visible far across the surrounding country. North America's highest peak bears a name derived from the Koyukon word for the high one. Glaciers flow from the mountain, among them the Kahiltna and Ruth, whose ice descends into long valleys on its southern side. In 1794 George Vancouver saw the distant snowy mountains while surveying Cook Inlet and recorded the view in his journal.
simp_chinese: 德纳里山高耸于阿拉斯加山脉之上，远在周边地区便能望见其覆雪的庞大山体。这座北美最高峰的名字源自科尤孔语，意为“高者”。冰川从山上流下，其中卡希尔特纳冰川与露丝冰川伸入南侧的漫长山谷。1794年，乔治·温哥华在勘测库克湾时望见远方的雪山，并将景象记入日志。

english: Denbigh's castle and town walls rise above the Vale of Clwyd in northern Wales. Built after Edward I's conquest, the stronghold guarded a new borough beneath its formidable gatehouse. In 1400 Owain Glyndŵr's forces attacked the town, but the castle held out. It was defended again for Charles I during the Civil War, until its Royalist garrison surrendered in 1646. The castle was later deliberately dismantled.
simp_chinese: 登比的城堡和城墙高踞威尔士北部克卢伊德谷地上方。要塞建于爱德华一世征服之后，坚固的门楼下是一座新设自治市镇。1400年，欧文·格林杜尔的军队袭击城镇，但城堡守住。英国内战中，守军再次为查理一世防守城堡，直到1646年投降。城堡后来被有意拆毁。

english: At the foot of Mount Song, Dengfeng is surrounded by temples, academies and monuments associated with the ancient idea that this was the centre of Heaven and Earth. Among them is Shaolin Temple, founded in 495 in the woods below Mount Shaoshi. Celebrated as a home of Chan Buddhism, the monastery also became renowned for the martial arts practiced by its monks. Southeast of Dengfeng stands an observatory built under the Yuan by the astronomer Guo Shoujing and his colleagues. Its brick and stone platform and graduated stone instrument served to measure the sun's shadow. Observations made here contributed to the calculations of the Shoushi calendar, a lasting achievement of Yuan astronomy.
simp_chinese: 登封坐落于嵩山脚下，四周寺庙、书院和古迹众多。古人认为这里是“天地之中”，山川与建筑因此蒙上一层神圣的意味。少室山林间的少林寺建于495年，既是禅宗重地，也因寺中僧人习练武艺而闻名。登封东南的观星台由元代天文学家郭守敬等人主持建造，砖石台体与石圭表用于测量日影。此处的观测成果参与了《授时历》的推算，留下元代天文学的一项重要成就。

english: Dengizkul is a shallow, saline lake in a closed depression south of the Bukhara oasis. Its name means “sea lake”, and the tenth-century geographer Ibn Hawqal marked a body of water in this country as the Sea of Bukhara. The shoreline changes as the amount of water varies, and salt deposits lie on the lake bed. Reeds and desert vegetation border the water, providing habitat for waterbirds amid the surrounding dry lowlands.
simp_chinese: 登吉兹库尔是布哈拉绿洲以南封闭洼地中的浅咸水湖。其名意为“海湖”，十世纪地理学家伊本·豪卡勒在地图上将这一带的一片水域标为“布哈拉海”。湖岸随水量变化而改变，湖底有盐沉积。水边生长着芦苇和荒漠植被，在周围干旱低地中为水鸟提供栖息地。

english: Dénia lies on the Mediterranean coast beneath a castle overlooking its harbour. In the eleventh century, as Daniya, it was the capital of a taifa whose maritime power reached the Balearic Islands. Its port and fortifications gave the town an importance that endured after the Christian conquest. In 1609 Dénia became a major point of embarkation for the forced expulsion of Valencia's Moriscos. Under orders of Philip III, families were gathered from the surrounding districts and sent overseas, leaving villages depleted and separating communities from homes they had known for generations.
simp_chinese: 德尼亚坐落在地中海海岸，城堡俯瞰港口。十一世纪，此地名为达尼亚，是一个泰法政权的都城，其海上势力延伸至巴利阿里群岛。港口和防御工事使城镇在基督徒征服后仍具有重要地位。1609年，德尼亚成为强制驱逐瓦伦西亚摩里斯科人的主要登船地点。按照费利佩三世的命令，周边地区的家庭被集中并送往海外，许多村庄因此人口锐减，社区与世代居住的家园被迫分离。

english: Denkanikottai stands in the hilly country of Baramahal, south of the Mysore plateau. Its name recalls a fort, one of the strongholds that gave the surrounding region its military importance. In the seventeenth century the rulers of Mysore contested Baramahal with local powers, and Denkanikottai was among the places brought under Mysore control in 1654. The district later passed to Haidar Ali, whose expanding state made these hill forts part of a wider struggle for southern India.
simp_chinese: 登卡尼科泰位于迈索尔高原以南的巴拉马哈尔丘陵地带。地名使人想起当地的堡垒；这类据点赋予周边地区重要的军事地位。十七世纪，迈索尔统治者与地方势力争夺巴拉马哈尔，登卡尼科泰于1654年落入迈索尔之手。该地后来归海德尔·阿里统治，他不断扩张的政权使这些山地堡垒卷入南印度更广泛的争夺。

english: The Denmark Strait separates Greenland's eastern coast from Iceland and connects the Arctic seas with the North Atlantic. The East Greenland Current flows south through the passage, carrying pack ice and icebergs along the coast. Winds and ocean conditions can push this ice toward Iceland, sometimes into bays and routes used by ships. The meeting of cold water, floating ice and the open ocean made the strait a demanding approach to both islands.
simp_chinese: 丹麦海峡将格陵兰东岸与冰岛分开，连接北极海域和北大西洋。东格陵兰洋流穿过海峡向南流动，沿海岸带走浮冰和冰山。风与海况可能将冰推向冰岛，有时进入海湾和船只航道。冷水、浮冰和外海在此交汇，使海峡成为通往两座岛屿的艰险水路。

english:
The Denmark Strait separates Greenland from Iceland and links the Greenland Sea with the Irminger Sea. Its narrowest span lies between Straumnes on Iceland's Hornstrandir peninsula and the Blosseville Coast of Greenland. A shallow submarine ridge crosses the passage, forcing deep, cold Polar water to plunge westward toward the Atlantic. The East Greenland Current follows the coast and carries pack ice and icebergs into southern waters.

Norse seafarers crossed this northern ocean during the medieval settlement of Iceland and Greenland. The passage remained hazardous because ice, fog and sudden weather could close a route that appeared open on a chart. Drift ice narrowed the usable water and carried hunters and whalers far from shore. The surrounding seas supported seals, fish and whales, attracting crews from northern Europe by the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries.

Whaling ships required sturdy vessels, skilled ice navigation and protected harbours on the Icelandic and Greenland coasts. The strait also shaped the movement of goods between the North Atlantic settlements and Europe, while its current carried floating hazards southward. Access depended on the season and the position of the ice edge. The Denmark Strait therefore became a strategic corridor between two large islands, defined less by fixed shores than by currents, depth and changing sea ice.
simp_chinese:
丹麦海峡把格陵兰和冰岛分开，连接格陵兰海与伊尔明格海。海峡最窄处位于冰岛豪恩斯峡湾半岛的斯特劳姆内斯与格陵兰布洛瑟维尔海岸之间。浅海脊横穿水道，迫使深层冷水向西倾泻进入大西洋。东格陵兰洋流沿岸南下，把浮冰和冰山带入南方海域。

中世纪诺斯人在冰岛和格陵兰定居时已经穿越这片北方海洋。浮冰、浓雾和骤变天气随时会封闭看似畅通的水道。漂流冰带不仅缩小可航水域，也把捕猎者和捕鲸者带离海岸。周围海面盛产海豹、鱼类与鲸，十七、十八世纪吸引北欧船员前来。

捕鲸船需要坚固船体、冰区航行技术和冰岛、格陵兰沿岸的避风港。海峡同时控制北大西洋居留地与欧洲之间的货物流动，洋流又把漂浮危险送往南面。可通行范围随季节和冰缘位置改变。丹麦海峡因此成为两座大岛之间的战略走廊，其形状由洋流、深槽和移动海冰共同界定。

english: The Denmark Strait separates Iceland from Greenland and joins the northern Atlantic to the seas of the Arctic. The cold East Greenland Current carries sea ice and icebergs southward through the strait, sometimes bringing them close to Iceland's northwestern shores. Wind and ocean conditions can drive ice eastward into bays and shipping routes. In earlier centuries severe ice years brought bitter cold to coastal districts and could be followed by losses of livestock and hunger.
simp_chinese: 丹麦海峡分隔冰岛与格陵兰，连接北大西洋和北极海域。寒冷的东格陵兰洋流将海冰和冰山沿海峡向南输送，有时靠近冰岛西北海岸。风与海况能使浮冰向东进入海湾和航道。早些世纪，严重的海冰年份会给沿岸地区带来严寒，有时还伴随牲畜死亡和饥荒。

english: The Denmark Strait lies between Greenland and northwestern Iceland, where the Westfjords face the open sea. Ice carried south by the East Greenland Current can approach this coast and enter fjords or obstruct fishing grounds. Behind the headlands, Skutulsfjörður offers a sheltered inlet within the larger Ísafjarðardjúp. Foreign merchants traded at Ísafjörður from the sixteenth century, bringing their ships into these waters despite the ice and changeable weather of the northern passage.
simp_chinese: 丹麦海峡位于格陵兰与冰岛西北部之间，冰岛的西峡湾在此面向外海。东格陵兰洋流向南输送的浮冰可能逼近海岸，进入峡湾或阻碍渔场。海角后方，斯屈图尔峡湾是伊萨峡湾深处的一条受庇护水道。十六世纪起，外国商人在伊萨菲厄泽贸易，船只驶入这里的水域，面对北方航路的海冰与多变天气。

english: Between Iceland and Greenland, the Denmark Strait carries cold water and ice southward from the Arctic. Icebergs from Greenland's glaciers mingle with sea ice in the East Greenland Current, and changing winds may carry them toward Iceland. Norse settlers crossed the wider North Atlantic from Iceland to Greenland in the late tenth century. Their voyages depended on finding a way through a northern sea where drifting ice and weather could make landfall uncertain.
simp_chinese: 冰岛与格陵兰之间的丹麦海峡，将北极的冷水与冰向南输送。格陵兰冰川脱落的冰山与海冰混杂在东格陵兰洋流中，风向变化又可能将它们带向冰岛。十世纪末，北欧定居者从冰岛横越更广阔的北大西洋前往格陵兰。他们必须穿过浮冰与天气可能使抵岸变得困难的北方海域。

english:
Denov stands between the Surkhandarya and Sangardak rivers, near the mountains that enclose the upper valley. Its name, recorded as Dehinav, means “new village”. The nearby ruins of Budrach mark the older city of Chaghaniyan, once the centre of a region of the same name; Denov grew north of that earlier town.

By the seventeenth century, the writer Mahmud ibn Wali described Dehinav as a fortified town with a fine bazaar, a large mosque and a khanqah. Under the Khanate of Bukhara it became a centre of caravan trade, and its crafts included leatherworking, weaving and embroidery. The Sayyid Atalik madrasa, dating from the sixteenth century, was among the largest institutions of its kind in Central Asia and bears witness to the town's religious life.
simp_chinese:
杰诺夫坐落在苏尔汉河与桑加尔达克河之间，靠近环抱上游河谷的群山。其名称见于史书中的德希瑙，意为“新村”。附近的布德拉奇遗址是古赤罕衍城的所在，那里曾是同名地区的中心；杰诺夫则在这座旧城以北逐渐兴起。

十七世纪的作者马赫穆德·伊本·瓦利将德希瑙描述为一座设防城镇，拥有繁华的巴扎、大清真寺和苏菲修院。在布哈拉汗国统治下，这里成为商队贸易中心，皮革加工、织造和刺绣等手工业兴盛。建于十六世纪的赛义德阿塔利克经学院是中亚规模最大的同类建筑之一，见证了当地的宗教生活。

english:
Densatil stood above the Yarlung Tsangpo, a great monastic seat of the Phagdru branch of the Kagyu tradition. It grew around the hermitage established by Phagmodrupa Dorje Gyalpo in 1158. His successors made it a centre of religious authority, renowned for elaborate gilded stupas that housed the relics of its abbots.

From the late thirteenth to the fifteenth century, eight monumental reliquaries known as tashi gomang were built at Densatil. Their many tiers and images celebrated successive abbots of the ruling Lang family. The monastery's influence extended into politics: between 1349 and 1354 Jangchub Gyaltsen challenged the authority of Sakya and established Phagdru rule in central Tibet, governed from nearby Neudong. Densatil's sacred monuments embodied the close ties between the monastery and that ruling house.
simp_chinese:
丹萨替寺坐落在雅鲁藏布江上方，是噶举派帕竹传承的重要寺院。它由帕木竹巴多杰杰布于1158年建立的修行处发展而来，历代继承者使之成为宗教中心。寺院以供奉历代住持舍利的精美鎏金佛塔闻名。

十三世纪末至十五世纪，寺内建成八座称为扎西果芒的大型舍利塔，层层雕像纪念统治家族朗氏的历代住持。寺院影响也延伸至政治：1349年至1354年间，绛曲坚赞挑战萨迦派权威，建立帕竹政权，从附近乃东治理卫藏。丹萨替的圣塔体现了寺院与这一统治家族的紧密联系。

english: Deo was the seat of a landed family in southern Bihar and is celebrated for its temple of the sun god Surya. The stone temple rises above the surrounding plain, its tower and carved details expressing a long tradition of worship. An inscription of the fifteenth century records a temple dedication by King Bhairavendra, linking the shrine to the local ruling house. Pilgrims gather at Deo to offer prayers to the sun.
simp_chinese: 提婆是比哈尔南部一个土地家族的驻地，以太阳神苏利耶的神庙闻名。石造寺庙高出周围平原，塔身和雕刻细节体现了悠久的祭祀传统。十五世纪的一篇铭文记载国王拜拉文德拉奉献寺庙，使神祠与地方统治家族相联系。朝圣者来到提婆向太阳神祈祷。

english: Deodar, also known as Diyodar, lies in the dry plains of northern Gujarat. It was the seat of a small state ruled by a branch of the Vaghela family. According to its recorded history, the family established itself at Bhildi after the overthrow of Rajput rule at Patan in 1297, before holding territory in this part of the northern Gujarat frontier. The little principality endured among the larger powers that succeeded the Vaghelas.
simp_chinese: 代奥达尔又称迪约达尔，位于古吉拉特北部干燥平原，是瓦盖拉家族一支统治的小邦驻地。据当地历史记载，1297年帕坦的拉杰普特统治被推翻后，该家族在比尔迪立足，后来在古吉拉特北部边区掌有领地。这一小邦在继瓦盖拉人之后崛起的较大势力之间存续。

english:
Deogarh stands above the Betwa River amid the hills of Bundelkhand. Its great Vishnu shrine, known as the Dashavatara temple, dates to the Gupta age and bears finely carved panels of Hindu mythology. A fort crowns the hill nearby, enclosing a remarkable group of Jain temples and sculptures reached by stone paths from the river.

The Jain sanctuary grew over many centuries, from the early medieval period into the seventeenth century. Images of the Tirthankaras, votive tablets and pillars filled the temples, testimony to generations of patrons and craftsmen. The fort and its sacred sites passed through the hands of several powers, including rulers of Delhi and Kalpi and later the Marathas. Their changing authority left Deogarh’s older monuments standing above the Betwa, where the steep ghats descend to the water.
simp_chinese:
代奥格尔位于本德尔坎德丘陵中的贝特瓦河上方。著名的十化身寺供奉毗湿奴，始建于笈多时代，其精美浮雕描绘印度教神话。附近山顶有一座堡垒，城内聚集着众多耆那教寺庙与雕像，石阶从河边通向高处。

耆那教圣所在许多个世纪中逐渐发展，从中世纪早期延续到十七世纪。寺庙中布满了渡津者神像、供养碑和石柱，见证一代代施主和工匠的奉献。堡垒与圣地先后归属不同势力，包括德里、卡尔皮的统治者以及后来的马拉塔人。政权更迭之中，古老的建筑仍立于贝特瓦河上方，陡峭的石阶通向河水。

english:
Deoghar, the abode of the gods, is a pilgrimage town centred on the shrine of Shiva as Baidyanath, the divine physician. Its sacred linga is revered among the twelve jyotirlingas. A group of smaller shrines surrounds the main temple, and pilgrims bring water from the Ganges at Sultanganj to offer at the shrine.

A local legend tells that Ravana won a linga from Shiva on condition that he never set it down on the journey to Lanka. Forced to stop, he entrusted it to a cowherd, who placed it on the ground at Deoghar, where it remained. The rulers of Gidhaur were patrons of the shrine. Tradition attributes work on the temple to Raja Puran Mal in the late sixteenth century, although the history of its original construction is less certain.
simp_chinese:
德奥加尔意为诸神的居所，是以湿婆化身“神医”拜迪亚纳特神祠为中心的朝圣城镇。神圣的林伽被尊为十二光明林伽之一。主寺周围环绕着较小的神祠，朝圣者从苏尔坦甘杰的恒河取水，带到这里供奉。

地方传说讲述罗波那从湿婆那里得到林伽，条件是在前往楞伽途中不能将它放下。他被迫停留时，将林伽托付给牧童，后者在德奥加尔把它放到地上，林伽便留在了那里。吉多尔统治者曾是神祠的赞助者。传统认为拉贾普兰·马尔于十六世纪末对寺庙有所营建，但最初建造的历史并不明确。

english:
Deokju, later known as Deokcheon, occupied a mountain basin where the Taedong River gathers tributaries between ridges of northern Korea. Its fields and wooded slopes supported grain farming, timber cutting and local exchange. Routes through the basin connected the Pyongan interior with the towns of Anju and the northern frontier.

Goryeo records call the district Wonyang or Yowon. In 1001 it was renamed Deokju and received a defense command, reflecting its place on the road system facing the northern border.
